jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position**: Project Coordinator IV (Sustainability)  
**Location**: Los Angeles CA.  
**Work Location**: In Office/on-site  
**Contract:** Long Term  
  
**Position Description:**  
The Project Coordinator IV – Sustainability provides project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the Build Sustainability Strike Team throughout the planning, scoping, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout of sustainability and energy-related capital improvement projects across the Los Angeles Community District.  
  
Working under the direction of the Sustainability Strike Team Lead, this position supports the Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers and coordinates with District personnel, Campus Administration, College Project Teams (CPTs), Program Management Office (PMO), Program Controls, and other stakeholders to support project budget development, funding verification, cost forecasting, financial reporting, and project establishment.  
  
The position supports Districtwide sustainability initiatives, including Energy Information Systems (EIS), Sustainability and Climate Action Roadmap, Building Management Systems (BMS), Central Plant and Local Building Decarbonization, Central Plant optimization, LED lighting upgrades, energy efficiency retrofits, renewable energy systems, Photovoltaic (PV), microgrids, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, electrification, and other sustainability-related capital improvement projects.

* Provide day-to-day project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers, and the Sustainability Strike Team throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare, organize, and maintain project management documents, records, correspondence, reports, and other project-related communications.
* Support project establishment and White Paper development by coordinating financial documentation, funding verification, preliminary budgets, cost estimates, and required reviews in accordance with established Build PMO Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Coordinate with District personnel, CPTs, PMO, Program Controls, and other stakeholders to verify project budgets, available funding, cost estimates, forecasts, and financial requirements.
* Coordinate with CPTs and PMO Cost Analysts to support budget establishment, monitoring, budget transfers, and accurate financial reporting.
* Develop and maintain cost forecasts and Estimates-to-Complete (ETCs); track Change Order Requests (CORs), commitments, and funding availability.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contract balances, remaining encumbrances, funding availability, and financial risks to identify potential shortfalls before they affect project delivery.
* Work with PMO Cost Analysts to verify the accuracy and integrity of project budgets and financial forecasts in accordance with established cost management procedures.
* Participate in change management and risk assessment meetings to identify cost-related trends, risks, exposures, and potential mitigation strategies.
* Perform monthly budget and cost reconciliations to support accurate month-end reporting and review expenditures across multiple funding sources.
* Coordinate with scheduling teams to assess cash flow and schedule performance impacts on costs, including variances, overruns, underruns, and forecasting concerns.
* Review financial reports, cost performance, and progress data; communicate material variances and potential financial risks to Project Managers and appropriate stakeholders.
* Track contract Periods of Performance (POP), contract balances, remaining encumbrances, and available funding.
* Coordinate invoice oversight and reconciliation with accounting and project stakeholders to support timely and accurate payment processing.
* Collaborate with PMO to validate project budget data, support stakeholder dashboards, and maintain accurate program controls databases and financial reports.
* Gather physical completion data and coordinate updates to project budget and forecast records as appropriate.
* Proactively identify funding issues that could delay procurement, contract execution, project initiation, or other critical activities.
* Support compliance with applicable District requirements, Build PMO SOPs, cost management procedures, and bond funding requirements throughout project development and implementation.
* Perform other bond-eligible project cost management and coordination duties as directed by the Sustainability Strike Team Lead.

**Minimum Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum of five (5) years of recent professional experience in engineering, project management, sustainability, project controls, cost management, and/or a related field.
* BS/BA degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sustainability, or a related field. Four additional years of qualifying experience beyond the minimum experience requirement may be substituted for the required education.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, financial modeling, budget tracking, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Proficiency with enterprise-level Project Management Information Systems (PMIS), such as Proliance, Trimble Unity, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong writing, analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and manage multiple project priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Project Coordinator supports the Program Management Office in the planning, tracking, and documentation of projects across PureTek Corporation’s pharmaceutical manufacturing operations. Working under the direction of the Program Office Manager, this position maintains project schedules, trackers, meeting records, and project documentation, and coordinates the logistics that keep projects moving — scheduling, material and equipment readiness, and follow-up on open action items. The Project Coordinator also provides on-floor support for line trials, solid dose pilot batch programs, and equipment qualification activities. This is a support role: the incumbent executes and maintains rather than sets project direction, and refers scope, schedule, and priority decisions to the Program Office Manager.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

* Maintains project schedules, task lists, and milestone trackers in Monday.com, updating status from input provided by project owners and functional departments.
* Schedules and coordinates project meetings; prepares agendas, records meeting minutes, and distributes action item logs with assigned owners and due dates.
* Follows up on open action items and outstanding deliverables, and reports status and aging items to the Program Office Manager.
* Maintains the PMO document repository, project files, and templates; confirms records are current, complete, correctly named, and retrievable.
* Processes change requests through the established change management workflow, including intake, routing for review, and documentation of approved changes.
* Escalates schedule slips, blocked tasks, and unresolved action items to the Program Office Manager in a timely manner.
* Coordinates with Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs to track the status of project-related documentation and approvals.
* Coordinates with Supply Chain, Planning, and Purchasing on the status of materials, components, and long lead-time items required for project activities.
* Assists the Program Office Manager with resource and capacity tracking by maintaining project loading and assignment records.
* Prepares meeting materials, presentation decks, and project summaries as directed.

**Technical Operations & R&D Support**
--------------------------------------

* Supports new component evaluations by scheduling trials, requesting samples and specifications from our sourcing team, and compiling evaluation findings into the established documentation format.
* Coordinates the logistics of line trials, including equipment and room availability, material staging, personnel scheduling, and data collection forms.
* Provides on-floor presence during line trials and Solid Dose Pilot Batch monitoring runs to record in-process observations and collect trial data.
* Assists R&D with the preparation of trial protocols, data collection forms, and trial summary reports.
* Attends Performance Qualification (PQ) activities during equipment and process onboarding; documents execution, logs open items, and notifies Quality of observed deviations.
* Maintains equipment onboarding trackers covering FAT, IQ, OQ, and PQ status and associated documentation.

**Qualifications Required**
---------------------------

* Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and directly related experience will be considered.
* 1–3 years of project coordination, administrative, planning, or manufacturing support experience, preferably in pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, or other regulated manufacturing environments.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including intermediate Excel (pivot tables, lookups, chart building); working familiarity with MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent scheduling software.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with demonstrated ability to track many open items across concurrent projects without dropping follow-up.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write accurate meeting minutes and concise status summaries.
* Ability to work in a manufacturing environment, including gowning requirements and extended periods standing on the production floor.
* Availability for occasional off-shift or weekend coverage during line trials and qualification activities.
* Ability to travel between PureTek facilities as required.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Exposure to GMP guidelines, controlled documentation practices, or change control.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish.
* Familiarity with solid dose operations (granulation, compression, coating, packaging) or personal care and liquid manufacturing.
* Familiarity with electronic quality management systems (MasterControl, ETQ, or equivalent) and ERP systems.
* CAPM certification or coursework toward a project management credential.

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

* Follow-through and reliability on committed dates
* Organization, attention to detail, and documentation discipline
* Clear, concise communication across shop floor and office audiences
* Cross-functional cooperation and responsiveness
* Sound judgment on when to resolve independently and when to escalate
* Adaptability in a fast-paced, regulated environment

jobs.title: Office Operations, Interior Design & Project Coordinator for General Contractor - Res Construction
jobs.description:
* **Company Overview**

**Lux Builders & Remodeling Inc. is a family-owned general contractor founded in 2005. The company specializes in high-end residential remodeling, new construction, and design-build projects across the South Bay and Los Angeles, and manages each project from planning and budgeting through design and construction.**

* **Position Summary**

**The Design & Project Coordinator supports remodel and new construction projects from the first client inquiry to the final walkthrough. The position is primarily office-based, with regular visits to showrooms and job sites. The Coordinator manages client communication, design selections, material sourcing, project systems, and the company’s social media presence as well as general office administrative operations.**

**Responsibilities**

**Client Relations and Leads**

* **Respond to incoming calls and inquiries, and represent the company professionally**
* **Schedule consultations and follow up with prospective clients**
* **Accompany clients to showrooms and assist with finish and fixture selections**
* **Provide clients with regular project updates**

**Design and Sourcing**

* **Review plans and specifications to prepare materials and finishes lists for each project**
* **Source tile, plumbing fixtures, lighting, hardware, and appliances**
* **Prepare selection sheets, compare pricing and lead times, and track orders and deliveries**

**Systems and Technology**

* **Develop and maintain digital tools such as selection trackers, order logs, client updates, and lead follow-up workflows, using AI platforms such as Claude or ChatGPT**
* **Maintain organized project files and support daily office operations**

**Marketing and Social Media**

* **Produce, edit, and publish at least one video reel per week featuring projects in progress and completed work**
* **Maintain active company profiles on Instagram, Facebook, Houzz, and TikTok**

**Field Support**

* **Conduct site visits to verify that installed finishes and fixtures match the approved plans and selections**
* **Report problems to the foreman and help coordinate material deliveries**

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* **Bachelor’s degree**
* **Minimum of 1 year of experience in residential construction, interior design, architecture, or a related field**
* **Proficiency in SketchUp**
* **Advanced, daily use of AI platforms such as Claude or ChatGPT, with examples of tools or workflows the candidate has built**
* **Ability to read blueprints, elevations, and finish schedules**
* **Strong construction math skills, including square footage, linear footage, material quantities with overage, and scale conversions**
* **Strong design sense and working knowledge of finishes, fixtures, and materials**
* **Professional, polished communication with high-end clients, both by phone and in person**
* **Exceptional organization and attention to detail**
* **Valid driver’s license and reliable vehicle**

**Preferred**

* **Proficiency in Revit**
* **Experience in sales, client service, or design consultation**
* **Video editing skills and a social media portfolio**

Pay: $30.00 - $31.00 per hour

Expected hours: 30.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

Experience:

* Interior Design: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Coordinator IV (Sustainability)
jobs.description:
At Avsar Construction Development, Inc., we are passionate about delivering high-quality, sustainable construction solutions that create a positive impact on both communities and the environment. Guided by the belief that safe and reliable shelter is a fundamental human need, we approach every project with a focus on innovation, responsibility, and long-term value.

While we are a growing company, our foundation is built on the extensive experience and expertise of seasoned construction professionals. Their diverse industry backgrounds and hands-on knowledge help us deliver the quality, service, and reliability clients expect, while maintaining the flexibility and forward-thinking mindset of a growing organization. As we continue to grow, we remain committed to raising the standard of excellence in construction and building a better future for the communities we serve.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a **Project Coordinator IV (Sustainability)** to support sustainability and energy-related capital improvement projects throughout planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout. Working closely with project managers, cost analysts, and stakeholders, this role provides project coordination, cost management, financial controls, and reporting support to help successfully deliver sustainability initiatives and capital construction programs.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare, organize, and maintain project management documents, correspondence, reports, records, and project communications.
* Support project establishment and White Paper development by coordinating financial documentation, funding verification, preliminary budgets, cost estimates, and required reviews.
* Coordinate with project teams and stakeholders to verify project budgets, funding availability, cost estimates, forecasts, and financial requirements.
* Support budget establishment, monitoring, budget transfers, and financial reporting activities.
* Develop and maintain cost forecasts and **Estimates-to-Complete (ETCs)**, while tracking commitments, funding availability, and **Change Order Requests (CORs)**.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contract balances, encumbrances, funding availability, and financial risks.
* Verify budget accuracy and financial forecasting data in accordance with established cost management procedures.
* Participate in change management and risk assessment meetings to identify cost-related risks and mitigation strategies.
* Perform monthly budget reconciliations and support month-end financial reporting.
* Coordinate with scheduling teams to assess schedule impacts on cash flow, forecasts, and project costs.
* Review cost performance, budget reports, and project progress data, and communicate financial risks and variances to project stakeholders.
* Track contract periods of performance, balances, encumbrances, and available funding.
* Coordinate invoice review and reconciliation activities to support timely payment processing.
* Support project dashboards, financial reporting systems, and program controls databases.
* Gather project completion data and update budget forecasts and financial records as needed.
* Identify funding issues that could impact procurement, contracting, project initiation, or delivery schedules.
* Support compliance with project procedures, cost management requirements, and bond funding guidelines.
* Perform other project cost management and coordination duties as assigned.

### **Requirements**

**Required Experience**

* Minimum **5 years** of recent professional experience in **engineering**, **project management**, **sustainability**, **project controls**, **cost management**, or **a related field**.

**Required Skills**

* Proficiency with**Microsoft Word**, **Outlook**, and **PowerPoint****.**
* Advanced proficiency in **Microsoft Excel**, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, financial modeling, budget tracking, and reporting.
* Experience with enterprise-level **Project Management Information Systems (PMIS)** such as **Proliance**, **Trimble Unity**, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while coordinating with diverse stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and writing skills.

**Required Education**

* Bachelor's degree in **Engineering, Construction Management, Sustainability,** or **a related field**.
* **4** additional years of qualifying experience may be substituted for the degree requirement.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting capital improvement projects within large public works or educational facility construction programs.
* Experience with project cost management, forecasting, **Estimate-to-Complete (ETC)** development, and funding verification.
* Familiarity with capital improvement program financial controls, budget management, and project establishment processes.
* Familiarity with **Division of the State Architect (DSA)** design and construction processes.
* Experience supporting energy efficiency, renewable energy, electrification, or sustainability-related capital improvement projects.
* Familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools such as Tableau or similar platforms.

### **What We Offer**

Finding the right workplace can make all the difference. That's why fostering a positive team environment, encouraging professional growth, and recognizing the value of every employee remain a priority as the company continues to grow.

**401(k) Retirement Plan**

Invest in your future with a retirement savings plan designed to help you achieve your long-term financial goals.

**Comprehensive Health Benefits**

Access medical, dental, and vision coverage to support your health and well-being, both on and off the job.

**Paid Time Off (PTO)**

Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and enjoy life

jobs.title: Program/Project Coordinator- Grant Administration
jobs.description:
**Overview**

As a Program/Project Coordinator – Grant Administration, you’ll coordinate grant and contract activities from proposal development through closeout. You’ll keep documentation organized, monitor compliance requirements, and work with internal teams, vendors, contractors, and public-sector partners to keep projects moving. Your impact: Clear records and timely compliance reviews help project teams meet grant obligations and deliver planned work responsibly.

**Duties**

* Coordinate grant project management, procurement, and contract management activities, including schedules, records, and required documentation.
* Review proposals, contracts, and supporting documents; assist with proposal writing, legal drafting, and technical writing.
* Support vendor and contractor management, public sector purchasing, pricing reviews, negotiation, and contract negotiation.
* Track compliance requirements and changes; apply relevant procurement regulatory knowledge, Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), and Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) principles as applicable.
* Maintain document and records management processes using Microsoft Office, Salesforce, and DocuSign; research issues and support strategic planning and change management.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in grant management, grant project management, procurement, contracts, or government contract management is preferred.
* Familiarity with compliance management, document review, vendor management, and contract administration is valuable.
* Knowledge of FAR, public sector purchasing, intellectual property law, and UCC law is preferred; experience with legal drafting or contract negotiation is an asset.
* Strong writing, research, organization, and business management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with Salesforce and DocuSign is preferred.

Pay: $27.31 - $32.89 per hour

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**The Greenridge Group** is a **prime contractor and consulting firm** specializing in Project and Construction Management for major public-sector agencies.

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented **Project Coordinator IV – Sustainability** to support the Los Angeles Community College District's (LACCD) BuildLACCD Sustainability Strike Team.

* **Project Controls:** Track change orders, contract balances, encumbrances, and financial risks to support successful project delivery.
* **Reporting & Analysis:** Prepare financial reports, analyze cost variances, and maintain accurate project data and dashboards.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work closely with Project Managers, Cost Analysts, campus teams, and program stakeholders to coordinate budgets, funding, and project activities.
* **Sustainability Initiatives:** Support capital improvement projects involving solar energy, battery storage, EV charging infrastructure, energy-efficient buildings, and decarbonization.

  
**Requirements**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* At least **5 years of recent professional experience** in engineering, project management, sustainability, project controls, cost management, or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sustainability, or a related discipline. An additional 4 years of qualifying experience may substitute for the degree.
* **Advanced Microsoft Excel skills**, including complex formulas, pivot tables, financial modeling, data analysis, and budget reporting.
* Experience with enterprise-level Project Management Information Systems (PMIS), such as Proliance, Trimble Unity, or equivalent systems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting large-scale public works, educational facilities, or capital construction programs.
* Hands-on experience with cost forecasting, budget management, funding verification, and Estimates-to-Complete.
* Familiarity with BuildLACCD or similar public-sector capital improvement programs.
* Knowledge of Division of the State Architect (DSA) processes.
* Experience with renewable energy, energy efficiency, electrification, or sustainability-related construction projects.
* Experience with Tableau or similar reporting and data visualization tools.

* Support communication and follow-ups with distributors, customers, and business partners.
* Coordinate shipping and logistics matters with external providers.

**4. Headquarters Coordination & Management Support**

* Serve as a communication liaison between the U.S. subsidiary and Korean headquarters.
* Prepare weekly operational updates, administrative reports, and financial summaries.
* Coordinate information and documentation between U.S. operations and headquarters.

* Previous work experience in accounting support, office administration, or business operations in the United States.
* Hands-on experience with bookkeeping, expense management, invoicing, or accounts receivable.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and other standard office software.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and reporting skills.
* Legally authorized to work in the United States.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in accounting, administration, or business operations.
* Experience using QuickBooks or similar U.S. accounting software.
* Knowledge of accounts payable (AP), accounts receivable (AR), and month-end closing procedures.
* Experience working in a small company, startup, or newly established subsidiary.
* Experience coordinating with external accountants, attorneys, vendors, or distributors.
* Experience in the medical device, healthcare, manufacturing, or distribution industries.

**Compensation & Benefits**

**Position Summary**

The Coordinator, IT & Administration keeps IT and Administration work organized and moving. The role coordinates projects, manages department invoices and reconciliations, handles scheduling and meeting follow-up, and supports onsite technology needs across GSGLA locations. **Project Coordination (about 35–40%)**

**Finance & Administration (about 25–30%)**

* Prepare and reconcile department credit card transactions, mileage, and expense reports in Concur for Director approval.

* Track software licenses, subscriptions, and renewals; assist with budget monitoring.
* Handle IT procurement, including equipment for new hires.

**Scheduling & Communications (about 15–20%)**

* Schedule and coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, and distribute notes and follow-ups.

* Help keep the SharePoint intranet and staff-facing IT instructions current.

**Onsite & Technology Support (about 10–15%)**

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Comfortable with technology and able to perform basic troubleshooting.
* Highly organized with excellent follow-through; confident holding others, including their manager, to agreed deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and good people skills with staff at all levels.
* Must be flexible, adaptable, and willing to thrive in an ever-changing environment.
* Ability to spend time sitting, utilizing the computer, and standing and walking throughout the facilities.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for travel between GSGLA locations throughout the region.
* Ability to lift up to 15 pounds periodically.
* Flexibility to attend evening and/or weekend meetings and/or events.
* Able to perform this job safely, without endangering the health or safety of themself or others.

**Recommended Education, Training and Experience**

* At least 2–3 years of experience in IT, administrative, or project coordination roles.
* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Experience with invoices, purchase orders, expense reports, and reconciliations.
* Preferred: Interest in AI and how it can support everyday work, with curiosity to learn and try new tools responsibly.
* Preferred: Some experience working with data, such as organizing, cleaning, or analyzing information in Excel, Lists, or reporting tools. AI and data go hand in hand, and this experience will support GSGLA’s growing data and AI work.

The USC Caruso Catholic Center seeks a highly organized, detail-oriented, and technologically proficient Advancement & Development Coordinator to support fundraising, donor relations, communications, events, and development operations.

The ideal candidate is an excellent writer with strong technical skills and demonstrated experience in donor database management, gift processing, financial reconciliation, and fundraising reporting. We seek a proactive, resourceful, and exceptionally detail-oriented professional who combines strong communication skills with technical expertise. A passion for the Catholic Center’s mission and values is essential.

Email Cover Letter and Resume to our hiring manager at hiring@catholictrojan.org

The Community Manager reports to the Director, Regional Manager, Area Manager, or Senior Community Manager. The Community Manager directly supervises a minimum of 1-3 personnel and/or temporary resources.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**COMPLIANCE**

* Ensure resident files and Yardi data are maintained in accordance with Compliance and Property Management policies and regulations.
* Review, process and approve all resident notices pertaining to recertification.
* Maintain property waiting list in accordance with the properties’ Tenant Selection Plan.
* Ensure applications for housing are processed in accordance with properties’ affordable housing covenants.
* Process annual re-certifications within established timelines.
* Comply with all aspects of Fair Housing and Harassment Awareness training and protocols in performance of all tasks and assignments

**PROPERTY OPERATIONS**

* Handle marketing and advertising for vacancies in accordance with properties’ Affirmative Fair Housing Marketing Plan.
* Ensure that all appropriate notices are remitted to residents in a timely manner and are completed and served within the requirements set forth in the lease.
* Visually inspect grounds, buildings, and apartment units on a regular basis between annual inspections.
* Manage office supply inventory and work closely with Resident Services to ensure maintenance supplies are purchased in a timely manner and in accordance with the approved budget.
* Work cohesively with resident services staff to ensure vacancies turn times are met in accordance with company policy.
* Ensure work orders are processed in Yardi within established timelines.

**FINANCIAL**

* Accurately account for and balance petty cash in accordance with company policies and procedures.
* Prepare deposits for banking and posts resident payments into Yardi within timelines established by management.
* Prepare management required month end reports.
* Manage account receivables and ensure past resident balance due receivables are turned over to collection agencies.
* Keeps resident ledgers accurate and works diligently with accounting to resolve any errors.
* Prepares annual budget

* Oversees a min. of 1-3 employees
* Train and be responsible for work performed by all staff members under his/her direction.
* Perform written evaluations of employees.
* Maintain accurate payroll records as required by the company. Review employee timecards on due date as well as commissions and/or bonus incentives; approve for payment within Payroll department deadlines

* Respond to all resident complaints in a timely and professional manner.
* Create a community of caring and excitement that is contagious for our residents and noticeable to the community at large.

**RESIDENT PROGRAMS**

* Manage ongoing positive relationships with all City staff and other local representatives and social service providers.

* Minimum of 1 year experience in Tax Credit

* Minimum of a high school education or equivalent

* Financial management
* Proficient in English language in verbal and written communications and in writing reports
* Computer literacy in Outlook, Word, Excel, and the Internet

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

LAX6 Consortium is an Airport Service Company managing operation and maintenance contracts for Airlines at LAX Airport.

This is (±$25/hr.) is a 40 hours per week opportunity. The candidate is willing to work any combination of three shifts per week (Mornings: 6AM to14PM, Afternoons: 14PM to 22PM or Graveyards: 22PM to 6AM) 24/7, 7 days a week. This position offers paid Medical + Dental & Vision for a minimal cost and offers choices of Life and Disability Insurance options, 401(K) retirement plan, stock share Options, FSA debit card of $4,500/Year.

**Responsibilities**

1. **Customer Service**: Represent LAX6 Consortium & AvAirPros Services with any interactions with Airlines, Vendors, LAWA and any stake holders of the LAX Airport

2. **Daily Gate Management:** Prepare Gate Plans from “Night of” airline information. Adjust daily Gate Plans on AODB according to any revisions made by member carriers. Notify all concerned of any changes or issues with gate assignments, i.e. late arrivals, delayed departures, tail swaps etc.… Prepare and advise airlines of pending issues and of any and all options available in an effort to insure the convenience of passengers and the timely expedition of flights.

3. **General Help Desk:** Respond to all calls and requests, log requests and incidents, create a work order (W.O.) if necessary, transmit the W.O. to the appropriate organization and monitor the W.O. from inception to completion.

4. **Information Dispatch:** Report to LAX6 Management, Airlines, Contractors and LAWA ARCC (*Airport Response Coordination Center) any major maintenance operations and system outages according to standard escalation procedures*

5. **Incident Management and Logging:** Maintain a log on all calls, incidents and requests made to the TOC received via Terminal, Vendor or Airline personnel. Logs in the database will include such information as time report was received, problem experienced, duration of problem and contact names.

o IT Calls response and restore times logging.

o 3 pictures jams over 2 minutes & USRs’ uploading in Data Base.

o Respond to PBB and BHS calls.

o GSE & Contractors vehicle/equipment move and monitoring.

o Tracking LAWA incident numbers

o Ramp Trash coordination.

o Monitoring and timeline documentation of power surges, code red, code 6-7…

o Monitoring & follow ups on BHS/PBB Google sheet.

o Coordination of gate closures for PBB PMs’/repairs and LAWA restriping/repairs.

o Updating FIDs and GIDS

o USRs monitoring and coordination.

o ETC…

6. **Data Collection and Reporting:** Maintain multiple logs for the purpose of collecting data and maintaining Key Performance Indicators for Terminal Systems and Vendors. Data will be used for Daily, Weekly, Monthly and Yearly reports produced by TOC personnel.

7. **BHS Monitoring:** Monitor BHS System Monitors to identify and prioritize any irregularities (Jams, Faults, Power outages, etc…) and dispatch them to the Contractor. Maintain a Photo Jam log and related reports.

8. **General:** Maintain all the Terminal Operation Center office equipment in good working order, conducting periodic checks. Manage Supplies and Parts Inventory. Perform office tasks as directed by the LAX6 staff.

9. **Phone Etiquette:** Answer all calls in a respectful manner while using proper phone etiquette by greeting the caller, stating your name, and gathering all information necessary to dispatch the proper service provider.

**Requirement:**

1. To be customer oriented.

2. To be driven to be a team player.

3**. Having at least 12 months of Airline/Airport experience**.

4. To think resourcefully under pressure.

5. To draft reports concisely in proper English.

6. To quickly learn the use of new software.

7. A minimum of High School diploma of its equivalent. Additional education is a plus.

8. To be able to pass FBI Fingerprint and background check.

Join us as a Terminal Operation Center Coordinator to lead critical airport functions that keep flights moving safely and efficiently! Your expertise will directly impact our operational success while providing you with opportunities for professional growth in the vibrant aviation industry.

Pay: From $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Representative, Tech Performance - Texas
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:  
Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE:  
The Tech Performance Sales Representative mission is to build positive and lasting relationships with current and future retail partners, consumers, and the performance community with a focus on Running, Golf, and Pickleball in the Texas market. As a key function of the brand, this role works closely with the Sports Marketing, Product, Marketing and their collective Sales teams to bring our brand to life at retail. We are looking for a driven, energetic and sports- passionate sales representative to join our growing Sports Performance team. We are looking for someone who is ready to hustle, build relationships and grow the Skechers brand across one of the most exciting sports markets in the country.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Primary Categories- Core Focus

* Drive Sales and market share growth across Skechers Running, Golf and Pickleball categories within your assigned Texas territory.
* Build and manage relationships with key retail accounts, run specialty dealers, golf-tennis pro shops, and sporting goods retailers.
* Execute seasonal sell-in meetings, present product lines, and close orders that meet and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Identify and develop new account opportunities and expand distribution and brand presence in the territory.

Secondary Categories- Supporting Role

* Support sales efforts across Tennis, Walking, Soccer and Basketball categories to deliver a full Skechers portfolio to retail partners.

Brand and Field Activation

* Collaborate closely with regional tech reps to educate retail staff and athletes on Skechers product technologies, innovations and performance benefits.
* Partner with Sports Marketing team to activate brand initiatives, athlete appearances, grassroots events, and in-store experiences across the territory.
* Represent Skechers at trade shows, sporting events, clinics, and community activations throughout Texas.
* Champion brand storytelling and help bring the Skechers performance identify to life at the retail level.

Planning and Reporting

* Develop and manage a territory business plan aligned with regional and national sales strategies.
* Track account performance, sell-through date, and competitive insights.
* Manage seasonal order books, re-orders and product assortment recommendations for each account.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU:

* BA or BS degree in Business or equivalent combination of experience.
* 1+ years Marketing/Sales/Retail experience required, 2+ years preferred.
* Running, Golf, Sports or Athletic industry experience highly preferred.
* Work experience within the running or golf community.

* Basic knowledge of retail math, inventory management, product merchandising and retail selling skills.
* Experienced self-starter with strong negotiation skills and entrepreneurial characteristics.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with strong time management abilities.
* Demonstrated aptitude for problem-solving and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Valid driver's license and clear driving record.
* Ability to lift and carry samples, sample bags, and marketing materials.
* Travel required (approximately 80%).
* You must be willing to live within an agreed upon radius of the territory you support.
* Highly motivated with a hardworking attitude and strong interpersonal skills.
* Works well independently, as well as within a team.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to understand the sport of running and empathize with runners to develop authentic relationships at retail and the running community at large.
* Ability to strategically use an annual budget that benefits the territory and brand.

The pay range for this position is $105,000-$110,000/yr USD.

**About Skechers**

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  
Skechers is committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and respectful work environment. Skechers provides equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment without regard race, color, religion, gender, gender identification and expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic established by local, state or federal law.

**Reasonable Accommodation**  
Applicants for employment who require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job should request appropriate accommodation by emailing benefits@skechers.com.  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each job responsibility satisfactorily. The skills, abilities and physical demands described are representative of those duties that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities, who are otherwise qualified for the job position, to perform the essential functions.

**Travel:**

**Inventory & Logistics Coordinator**

Gardena, CA

OPEN Healthcare is an advanced laboratory committed to enhancing the quality of life for our patients. Our laboratory is equipped with state-of-the-art technology, aiming to deliver sustained quality of services. At OPEN Healthcare, we provide high-quality, reliable, and affordable laboratory and diagnostic services, ensuring accurate and rapid test results. Our extensive test menu designed to meet your health and wellness needs. OPEN Healthcare specializes in esoteric clinical tests including allergy, molecular testing, and other custom assays with mass spectrometry. Learn more aboutOPEN Healthcare at www.ohcus.com.

This role is ideal for someone who is organized, detail-oriented and takes pride in accurate records and reliable follow-through. As our Inventory & Logistics Coordinator, you will play a key role in keeping our laboratory and collection sites fully stocked by managing inventory in Fishbowl and Excel, preparing supplies and requisitions, and making sure the right materials are in the right place on time.

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage laboratory and phlebotomy supply inventory in Fishbowl and Excel, keeping accurate, up-to-date records of all items received, issued and transferred
* Prepare, pack and fulfill supply requisitions and orders for departments, collection sites and clients, verifying quantities and meeting turnaround standards
* Receive, inspect, unpack and store incoming shipments; reconcile against purchase orders and packing slips and report any discrepancies
* Perform regular cycle counts and monthly inventory reconciliations; investigate and resolve variances and support inventory valuation reporting
* Monitor stock levels and reorder points; prepare purchase requests and coordinate with vendors to prevent shortages and manage expiration dates
* Communicate proactively with your supervisor, laboratory staff and client services about supply status, delays and backorders, escalating issues early
* Maintain clean, organized and safe storage areas in line with laboratory safety and handling protocols
* Print, stock and distribute requisition forms and other laboratory documents as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned. All employees may be asked to take on additional projects or responsibilities outside of this document, including but not limited to covering for colleagues or handling unexpected tasks, as business needs require.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

* **Integrity:** Exercises sound judgment and handles confidential information with discretion.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
Douglas Adams once said, **"Technology is a word that describes something that doesn't work yet."** Funny, because it's true. So much so that it sparked our unrelenting mission to increase the positive impact of technology on people's lives.

From robot vacuums and voice assistants to banking apps, smart toys, and backyard grills, Centercode has helped shape countless products in virtually every household, and chances are good we've impacted your life already. We're full of people who take pride in striving toward our goals and having a blast while doing it. We're always on the lookout for enthusiastic, like-minded people to join us in making everyday life better through technology.

As a **Strategic Account Manager**, you'll own some of our largest and longest-standing customer relationships, including enterprise product teams at consumer electronics and technology companies, each worth $100,000 to $250,000 a year. While a Renewals Account Manager focuses on our more predictable renewal book, you'll own our more complex enterprise relationships and mid-market accounts through renewal and expansion. Your job is to keep them, grow them, and make them less dependent on any one person, including you. You'll know each account's org chart, product calendar, and what's at stake in their next launch, and you'll be the reason they renew. You'll also help improve our account practices so relationships, plans, and customer knowledge are shared across the team.

**What you'll get:** a focused book of well-known brands, a seat in the conversation as we bring UserVolley, our AI-era product validation platform, to our existing customers, and direct access to our executives.

**What you'll do as a Strategic Account Manager**

*Own the relationship*

* Own 8-12 enterprise accounts and 15-20 mid-market accounts, about $3M in annual recurring revenue
* Take over accounts from prior owners without losing momentum
* Build relationships with the day-to-day program owners, their managers, the budget holders, and procurement
* Know each customer's product roadmap and launch calendar as well as they do
* Recognize and act on events that create urgency (a new product leader, a rough launch, a reorg)
* When a champion leaves, find their successor and rebuild the relationship before renewal
* Represent the customer's voice to Product and Marketing

*Renewals*

* Run each renewal on our 120-day plan so procurement never becomes a surprise
* Negotiate terms, timing, and multi-year agreements with customer stakeholders, backed by RevOps and Finance
* Flag risk early and lead the save plan with Services and Support
* Forecast renewals and expansion accurately

*Expansion*

* Initiate conversations with new teams, leaders, and product groups inside your accounts
* Develop relevant needs into qualified expansion opportunities
* Introduce the right Centercode product where it addresses a clear customer need
* Work with Product and a Solutions Consultant to validate fit and adoption or migration path
* Build the business case your champion needs to win budget internally

*Account planning and rhythm*

* Write and keep a living account plan for every account: stakeholder map, renewal path, expansion thesis, and risks
* Run executive business reviews that show outcomes their leadership cares about
* Keep every account, contact, and opportunity current in HubSpot the same day something changes
* Own retention and net growth in your assigned book
* Review risks and expansion progress regularly and measure outcomes over the agreed renewal periods
* Partner with our GM as executive sponsor on top accounts

*Scale yourself*

* Put AI agents to work on account research, meeting prep, and follow-ups, reviewing what they produce
* Build and share practical account workflows and practices the whole team can use
* Maintain clear stakeholder maps and records so any teammate can step in with confidence

**What you need** **to do the job**

*Experience and skills*

* Experience owning renewals and expansion for complex B2B technology accounts
* Direct commercial responsibility for enterprise relationships of $100K+ in annual value
* Named logos you've kept and grown, with the numbers to back it up (gross and net retention by year)
* Proficiency leading renewals and expansions through procurement, legal, and security review at large companies
* Comfort in executive conversations with directors and VPs of product, quality, research, or CX
* Proven ability to craft and present compelling account plans and business cases, on paper and in the room
* Hands-on AI skills for account research, stakeholder mapping, preparation, and follow-up, with output you can verify and explain

*Mindsets and traits*

* Invested in the whole account, not just your main contact
* Calm under pressure when a renewal goes sideways
* Curious about the customer's business and how their products ship
* Organized and forecast-honest, avoiding surprises at quarter end
* Resourceful and proactive when there's no detailed playbook
* Generous with relationships, customer knowledge, and credit

**What'll give you an edge**

* Experience with consumer electronics, connected hardware, or big tech customers
* Background in beta testing, user research, QA, or product management tooling
* You've taken over a book of accounts from someone else without losing any
* Experience introducing a new product to an existing customer base
* Familiarity with a structured framework such as MEDDICC for expansion deals
* Experience introducing new account practices or rebuilding a relationship while customer needs and the product were changing

**The nitty-gritty**

* Compensation: $115k - $130k base + commission ($165k - $185k OTE), with accelerators above plan
* This is a full-time, hybrid position
* Candidate must live within commuting distance of our HQ office (Mission Viejo, California)
* Candidate must be willing and able to travel up to 20% for on-site customer visits
* Sorry, recruite

jobs.description:
San Mateo County Health is seeking a dynamic and experienced leader to serve as the **Equity, Systems and Process Improvement Community Program Specialist II – In-Home Supportive Services Public Authority (ESPI CPS II)** within Aging and Disability Services (ADS).

This position supports the ongoing improvement and modernization of the In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS) Public Authority (PA) by developing automated systems, dashboards, and digital tools that enhance program operations, service accessibility, and staff productivity. The role also assists with caregiver recruitment and onboarding, referral coordination, and the development of policies, procedures, and training materials, while ensuring that all initiatives incorporate racial equity, diversity, and inclusion principles.

**Important Note:** The IHSS PA ESPI Community Program Specialist **is not a County classified position;** however, the role reports directly within ADS. The eligible list generated from this recruitment may be used to fill future extra-help, term, unclassified and regular classified vacancies.

This is a full-time position working Monday–Friday. A hybrid schedule may be available; however, approximately four on-site workdays per week are anticipated based on operational needs and County requirements. The position is currently located in San Mateo, CA, but will relocate to South San Francisco, CA, planned for March 2027. The role requires travel throughout the County and periodic travel within the State of California.

**About the IHSS Public Authority**

Established by the San Mateo County Board of Supervisors in 1993, the IHSS Public Authority administers the care provider components of the County’s IHSS program.

IHSS supports Medi-Cal eligible individuals who are aged, blind or living with disabilities at any age so they can safely remain in their homes as an alternative to institutional care.

**The IHSS Public Authority:**

* Serves as the employer of record for approximately 10,000 IHSS care providers
* Operates a Registry that recruits, screens, and refers care providers to IHSS recipients
* Conducts background checks in accordance with IHSS regulations
* Provides training opportunities to enhance care provider skills
* Offers support to both recipients and care providers to promote successful working relationships
* Administers payroll, personnel services, health benefits, and COBRA
* Maintains employment records, conducts verifications, and responds to subpoenas
* The IHSS PA is advised by the Public Authority Advisory Committee (PAAC), appointed by the Board of Supervisors, with a majority of the members being current or former IHSS recipients and/or care providers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**The** **IHSS PA ESPI Community Program Specialist** **will:**

* Assist in development and maintenance of systems, automated tools, and improvement charters designed to boost IHSS PA operations utilizing both AAS’ Racial Equity Action Plan (REAP) and LEAP process improvement standards
* Implement Quality Assurance (QA) standards in the development and maintenance of dashboards and reporting systems that will be used in IHSS PA work processes, as well as monitor staff workload and productivity
* Assist in the development and maintenance of a self-service portal for referral submissions by external entities
* Assist in the development and maintenance of an online job board intended to help match IHSS recipients with care providers, implementing equity, diversity, and inclusion standards.
* Assist in the migration of paper-driven onboarding processes to digital processes, a process that will expedite accessibility of newly hired care providers to IHSS recipients
* Assist in recruiting and onboarding care providers, to help remediate the current care provider shortage, utilizing a racial equity lens
* Work with the IHSS PA Supervisors to devise, triage, and assign referrals to Payroll Specialists and Registry Social Workers
* Work closely with IHSS Community Program Analysts in the development and maintenance of automation-related projects designed to enhance the accessibility of Payroll and Registry services for IHSS recipients
* Update existing and create new IHSS PA policies and procedures to reflect current and new programmatic practices
* Update existing training materials and training IHSS PA staff, integrating a social and equity lens

The **ideal candidate** will be:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, well suited for large government or non-profit social service programs.
* Experience working with case management databases like the Case Management, Information and Payrolling Services (CMIPS II) and Microsoft Suite Applications (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Excel).
* Experience with process improvement best practices and LEAP process improvement principles and methodologies.
* Experience training community members and/or staff in programmatic updates and new operational requirements requiring updated work practices.
* Strong understanding of social and racial equity principles leading to the County of San Mateo’s Equity Framework.

**Qualifications**
------------------

***Knowledge of:***

* Principles, practices, and administrative requirements of the program to which assigned.
* Contemporary social, political and economic trends and problems related to community services.
* Principles of social planning and program development related to community services.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Judicial Council of California is accepting applications for the position of Administrative Coordinator with the Center for Judicial Education and Resources.

The Administrative Coordinator position schedules and performs project management and logistical tasks required to deliver education programs and products for judges, court managers and court personnel. Staff work directly in support of faculty and collaborate with attorneys and education developers responsible for the training and recruitment of faculty and creation of course content. They coordinate the work performed by staff providing A/V Support Services, Distance Education/Media Production, meeting planning and contracting, course and program registration, printing, and mailing, and provide program management for live programs, supporting faculty and working with local site personnel. Staff work independently on more than one assigned program or product at a time and are responsible for coordinating the implementation of a variety of delivery mechanisms including but not limited to the following: in-person conferences, statewide institutes, regional education courses, local training courses, webinars, online videos, podcasts, and videoconferences.

This position is responsible for providing the full range of administrative coordination and project management duties required to deliver multiple education programs currently planned and approved by the Judicial Council as part of the Judicial Branch Education Plans. In order to ensure the work of the office is completed within budget and on time, assignments will be flexibly rotated, therefore, this position is expected to be capable of performing all coordinator duties.

**The Judicial Council**
  
The Judicial Council of California is the policy setting body for the state court system and has constitutionally conferred statewide rule-making authority. This authority includes developing, advocating for, and allocating the judicial branch budget. A majority of Council members are California state justices and judges; however, the Council also includes lawyers, legislators, and court administrators.

As employees of the council, every member of staff should view and approach their work as one Judicial Council with a public service mission that is greater than the sum of its parts.

The Judicial Council strives for work-life balance, including substantial vacation and holiday time. In addition, we offer an excellent benefits package, including pension, medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending, up to $130 per month reimbursement for qualifying commuting costs, student loan forgiveness as part of Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), and retirement savings plans. The San Francisco office is only a 7-minute walk from the downtown Civic Center BART station. In Sacramento, the office is located minutes from downtown, just north of Discovery Park.

The Judicial Council offers hybrid work arrangements for many positions. The successful candidate will be expected to work in person at the Judicial Council’s San Francisco or Sacramento office at least two days per week, based on their office leader’s direction, and reside in the areas surrounding these locations. To be eligible for Judicial Council employment and participation in the Judicial Council’s Hybrid Work Program, a prospective or current employee’s primary residence/remote work location must be in the State of California and within a 150-mile driving radius of their assigned reporting location.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Field Marketing Manager**
===========================

**Pi.Security** · San Francisco, CA · Full-time · Hybrid or West Coast Remote

**About Pi.Security**
---------------------

Pi is building an agentic product security platform for teams that need to secure software at the speed they build it.

Modern development is accelerating, but security knowledge is still scattered across code, tickets, documents, incidents, reviews, and the people who remember why decisions were made. Pi turns that context into institutional security memory, helping teams triage faster, remediate in context, prevent repeat vulnerability classes, and embed security guardrails where engineering work already happens. We are building for a future where security is not a blocker at the end of the development process. It is part of how software gets designed, reviewed, shipped, and improved.

Pi was recognized on Fast Company's 2026 Next Big Things in Tech list and covered by Forbes!

**About the Role**
------------------

Pi is looking for a Field Marketing Manager to bring Pi to life in the rooms where our buyers gather and build the relationships that move deals forward.

This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on role. You’ll support Pi’s event programs, creating branded experiences, community events, and industry conference moments that put Pi in front of product security and application security leaders, CISOs, security engineers, and developers.

This is an individual contributor role on the marketing team, reporting to the VP of Marketing. The role is remote and must be based in the U.S. Pacific time zone, with a strong preference for a California metro area, and includes travel to events.

We’re looking for someone who is exceptionally organized, a creative thinker, close to the field, and equally comfortable designing an executive event series and rolling up their sleeves to make sure the booth ships on time.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Support regional event programs.** Plan, execute, and manage a portfolio of events, including brand experiences, executive and community events, partner events, and industry-specific gatherings. Make sure every event reflects the Pi brand and ties directly to our marketing goals.
* **Run events end to end.** Oversee every part of planning and execution, from registration and shipping to setup, day-of support, and post-event wrap-up. You sweat the details so attendees never have to.
* **Support our biggest moments.** Help bring Pi to life at larger tradeshows and tentpole events. Coordinate with vendors, manage logistics, and keep the brand consistent across every touchpoint.
* **Partner closely with the field.** Work hand in hand with the broader Pi marketing team so event messaging and goals connect to company priorities. Support event programs that put Pi in front of the right accounts at the right time.
* **Build with our partners.** Manage relationships with event partners, ensuring timely execution and high-quality outcomes. Develop programs with partners that turn events into measurable results.
* **Spend wisely.** Manage the budget for regional events, finding cost-effective approaches without compromising the quality of the experience.
* **Measure what matters.** Work with Marketing Ops to track attendance, manage list uploads, and evaluate every event against clear KPIs. Share post-event reports and insights that make the next event better than the last.
* **Own SWAG.** Manage inventory, coordinate distribution at events, and make sure our SWAG is something people actually want to keep.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 4+ years of B2B marketing experience with a focus on field marketing and events.
* Proven experience managing both small-scale, high-touch events and large-scale tradeshows.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills. You can juggle multiple events at once without dropping a detail.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills, with experience managing vendors, partners, and budgets.
* A creative mindset and a passion for curating experiences people remember long after the event ends.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a sharp eye for detail.
* Experience partnering closely with sales and cross-functional teams to align programs to pipeline and company goals.
* The ability to adapt to changing priorities and stay calm in high-pressure, fast-moving situations.
* Low ego and high ownership. You’re comfortable with hands-on execution, including on event day.
* Ability to travel 25% + of the time.

**Why Pi**
----------

Pi Security recently emerged from stealth with a $35 million Series A led by Third Point Ventures and Brightmind Partners, with backing from leading cybersecurity investors and operators, including CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz and Armis founders Yevgeny Dibrov and Nadir Izrael.

Founded by former Microsoft security researcher Guy Arazi and Yoni Ramon, who led offensive security work at Tesla, Pi is building an agentic Product Security platform that helps organizations secure software as fast as they build it.

Pi turns an organization’s engineering and security knowledge into institutional memory, giving teams the context to prioritize what matters, remediate vulnerabilities at the root cause and across every variant, and secure the entire software development lifecycle from design to production.

Pi is already trusted by leading AI companies and enterprise innovators, including xAI, Notion, Navan, Lemonade, and Teramind, and has expanded its ecosystem through AWS Marketplace and a strategic partnership with Bugcrowd.

As AI transforms how software is built, Pi is redefining Product Security for this new era.

You’ll join at a stage where field marketing can have an outsized impact. You’ll build alongside a humble, passionate, ambitious, and genuinely fun team that cares deeply about what we’re building and our customers.

We hire for four things, and we work this way every day

We're on a mission to transform an industry that's been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We're hiring a **Territory Account Manager** at our rental facility in **Newark, CA** and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. Territory Account Managers will be responsible for expanding our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Core Solutions branches offer construction equipment rentals including aerial equipment, earth moving equipment, material handling equipment and more.

**Pay:** $150,000 - $600,000 Total Compensation ($24,000 base salary + Uncapped commission with no market restrictions)

### **Primary Responsibilities**

* Territory management of a geographical area. Responsible for the full sales strategy execution from market analysis, sales forecasting, pipeline management and revenue growth, through contract negotiation and customer retention.
* Quickly respond to inbound leads and requests. Familiar with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.

Tell them about the numerous ways EquipmentShare can help save them money, make more money and operate more efficiently. In other words, educate them on how EquipmentShare solves their problems!
* Maintain and nurture existing customer relationships to ensure our customers are 100 percent satisfied with the level of service and support they receive from EquipmentShare. Keep them up-to-date about new or additional ways in which EquipmentShare can help improve their business with our comprehensive jobsite solutions.

Because we do things differently — and we think you'll feel it from day one. We're a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn't just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you're behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports *you*, and you drive *us* forward.

We're a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we're looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of **building something special**.

You want to be part of a team that's not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we're transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you're excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We're looking for people who:

See challenges as opportunities  

Embrace change and continuous improvement

For apartment owners, we're a fast way to fill units and earn more from them. We handle everything from furnishing to guest turnover, so our partners don't have to do any of the work.

**The role**

Most people have never heard of Landing.

That's our biggest marketing challenge, and our biggest opportunity. When people discover us, they quickly realize there's a better alternative to hotels, Airbnbs, or traditional leases. The problem is most people don't know that an alternative exists. As our first social hire, you'll change that.

You’ll own our social presence from end to end, with paid social as the core of the job. You’ll build it into a growth engine that drives awareness, engagement, and ultimately, booked reservations. Organic social supports this: it's where we find our voice, test ideas, and identify creative worth scaling. This isn't social for the sake of likes or impressions. Success is measured by real business impact: introducing Landing to new audiences and turning that attention into customers.

You'll be the first person to own this function. Reporting to the Senior Director of Performance Marketing, you'll have the budget, creative freedom, and autonomy to experiment, move quickly, and build a social program from the ground up, without waiting on layers of approvals.

**What you'll own**

* Paid social across Meta, TikTok, Reddit, YouTube, and whatever earns its place next. Full budget authority. You'll own the paid social budget, with the autonomy to allocate spend, test new platforms, and scale what works. Measured on booked revenue and customer acquisition cost, tested for incrementality - not last-click.
* Organic social as a real channel, not a posting calendar. Organic is where we find our voice and test creative cheaply. The winners graduate to paid. Judged on audience growth, engagement that converts, and lift in people searching for us by name.
* The creative itself. You'll write it, direct it, and, in many cases, make it. We're not just going to hand you finished assets and ask you to buy against them.
* Testing. Audiences, hooks, formats, landing pages. Weekly cycles, documented results, and a real answer to "did this add anything we wouldn't have gotten anyway?"
* Some owner-facing content. Roughly 20% of our audience is multifamily owners and asset managers, mostly on LinkedIn. Different message, same discipline.
* Expect roughly 70% of your time on paid social, and the other 30% on consumer organic and owner-facing content.

**The creative bar**

* Our best-performing work names what's wrong with the alternatives. It's sharp, specific, and occasionally funny. It is not a beautifully shot film about belonging.
* If your portfolio is all polished brand work with no performance behind it, this probably isn't a fit. If you’ve made scrappy work that outperformed the expensive stuff and you can prove it (thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CPA), send that.

**What we're looking for**

* 3+ years running paid social with real budget authority; you've personally owned the spend and been accountable for its return, not just its delivery.
* You make things. Copy, static, short-form video, whatever the platform is rewarding this quarter. Concept to post, without waiting on a designer.
* Organic instincts. You know what makes people stop scrolling and what makes them follow, and you can tell the difference between a post that performed and a post that mattered.
* You think about incrementality. Holdouts, geo splits, or something equally honest. You know why platform-reported ROAS is generous.
* Numbers don't scare you. CAC, payback, contribution. You can defend a budget request with math.
* You're resourceful and analytical. When performance drops, you don't wait for someone to tell you what to do. You diagnose the problem, develop a hypothesis, and get to work testing a solution.
* You're AI native. You've used AI in your daily workflow for the last couple of years, with a real point of view on what you've used it to generate, iterate, and automate, and where it falls down.
* Volume over polish. Something imperfect this week beats something perfect next month.
* You're a fast learner. The platforms change constantly, and you pick up new tools and new ways of buying quickly.
* You can work daily from our San Francisco office.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary:** $95K to $120K base (dependent on experience)
* **Bonus:** Performance bonus
* **Equity:** Included
* **Benefits:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and AD&D, Disability, Mental Health, Pet, Commuter, and FSA or HSA
* **Retirement:** 401(k) plan and access to ImmediatePay
* **PTO:** Generous PTO

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Located in the heart of Silicon Valley, Tenergy is a total power solution provider in the rechargeable battery and renewable energy industry. With over 20 years of reputation and track record, Tenergy is a recognized leading battery brand and Power solution partner in the fast growing renewable energy sector. Tenergy serves broad spectrums of customers for their applications including consumer electronics smart devices, industrial application, medical, electrical transportation and power storage. The application and business possibility with our products is endless with increasing needs for mobility and durable power. Tenergy offers competitive products in the market due to our global logistics, scale, quality, and commitment to customer satisfaction.

 **Job Description**

Tenergy Corporation is seeking a Logistics Operations Coordinator to support our daily logistics, shipping, and warehouse operations. This is a hands-on role that combines shipping and freight coordination with daily warehouse activities. The position works closely with the sales, warehouse, customer service, and accounting teams to process shipments, provide freight quotations, coordinate carriers, manage inventory-related transactions, and ensure customer orders are fulfilled accurately and on time. The role also involves hands-on order picking, packing, labeling, and shipment preparation as needed.

This position is well suited for either a motivated recent college graduate seeking to build a career in operations and logistics or an experienced operations professional who enjoys a combination of logistics coordination and hands-on operational work in a fast-paced environment.

**Duties may include**

**Logistics & Shipping**

* Prepare domestic and international shipping quotations for the sales team using parcel and freight carriers.
* Select the most cost-effective and reliable shipping methods based on shipment size, destination, delivery requirements, and customer needs.
* Schedule parcel, LTL, and truckload shipments with UPS, FedEx, and freight carriers.
* Monitor shipments and proactively resolve delivery delays, damage claims, or transportation issues.
* Maintain shipment tracking records and provide shipment status updates to internal teams and customers.
* Coordinate special project shipments and customer-specific logistics requirements.

**Warehouse Operation and Coordination**

* Coordinate with teammates to ensure timely receiving, inventory transfers, order pulling, and outbound shipments.
* Verify receiving records, inventory movements, and warehouse transactions before processing ERP updates.
* Assist in investigating inventory discrepancies and help maintain inventory accuracy.
* Support warehouse workflow planning to improve shipping efficiency and on-time order fulfillment.
* Order picking, packing, labeling, and shipment preparation as needed to support daily operations.

 **Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Relevant internship or work experience in logistics, warehouse operations, customer service, or operations is a plus.
* Experience with ERP systems is preferred.
* Experience with UPS, FedEx, freight carriers, Amazon Seller Central, or ShipStation is a plus.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office skills.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
* Self-motivated with a strong customer-service mindset and the ability to work effectively across departments.
