The Research Foundation for Mental Hygiene, Inc. (RFMH) is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented candidate for the position of Administrative Coordinator in the Department of Comparative Medicine (DCM) at the New York State Psychiatric Institute (NYSPI).

Reporting directly to the Director of DCM, the Administrative Coordinator will provide administrative support to the Director and other DCM management. The Administrative Coordinator will manage the department's animal census data, maintain training records, and update website content. The incumbent will assist with the day-to-day operations through accurate record keeping, timely communication, and well-organized administrative processes.

Key responsibilities include calendar and meeting management, stakeholder communications, budget support, preparation for AAALAC and state inspections, animal census management and reconciliation in Tick@Lab.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Departmental Communication & Administrative Operations

* Serve as the DCM office's primary point of contact for administrative inquiries from investigators, research staff, vendors, and other stakeholders, providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses.
* Manage calendars for the Director and other DCM management. Schedule meetings, coordinate appointments, and prepare and route general administrative correspondence.
* Plan, schedule, and coordinate weekly animal care staff and supervisor meetings; prepare agendas, record accurate minutes, and track action items through completion.
* Coordinate and support preparation for triennial AAALAC site visits and the annual state inspection, including scheduling, document collection, and facility logistics.
* Operations & Budgetary Support

* Provide backup support for operational tasks (e.g., cage card printing and order review) and daily administrative workflows.
* Track invoices, vendor payments, and departmental expenses.
* Track and process annual institutional and individual membership renewals, ensuring timely filing and documentation.
* Assist the Director with budget estimations, tracking, and annual fiscal planning.

* Manage, audit, and reconcile animal census data (via Tick@Lab) to ensure data integrity, compliance, and accurate per diem billing.
* Maintain and optimize system configurations related to cage card census tracking, reconciliation workflows, error detection, and reporting.

* Serve as the primary liaison to NYSPI IT (psyIT) and software vendors (a-tune, the Tick@Lab vendor) to report and resolve technical issues; assist with system testing, updates, and configuration changes.
* Content Management & Training Support

* Assist with the development, formatting, maintenance, and publication of training materials, presentations, and learning modules for the DCM website and training platforms.
* Coordinate and maintain departmental electronic document management systems (e.g., OneDrive) and website content.
* Maintain and systematically track training records and compliance documentation for all personnel in the animal care and use program.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Associate's degree or higher from an accredited institution, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of two (2) years of administrative support experience in a scientific, academic, medical, or research environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* High proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Excel, including sorting, filtering, lookups, and pivot tables) and experience with digital document management platforms (e.g., OneDrive, SharePoint).
* Experience with specialized compliance software or animal management databases (e.g., Tick@Lab).
* Knowledge of regulatory standards related to animal research (OLAW, AAALAC).
* Experience supporting an AAALAC-accredited animal care program or IACUC office.
* Experience maintaining website or intranet content (e.g., SharePoint sites, WordPress, or similar content management systems).

**Work Location:** 1051 Riverside Drive, New York, NY 10032

**To Apply:** Submit an application through our website at https://rfmh.applicantpro.com/jobs/. Please note only applications submitted through our website will be considered.

The Mission of the Research Foundation for Mental Hygiene, Inc. (RFMH) is to promote the mental health of all New Yorkers, with a focus on providing hope and supporting recovery for adults with serious mental illness and children with serious emotional disturbances. Applicants with lived mental health experience are encouraged to apply. RFMH is deeply committed to supporting underserved individuals, organizations, and communities. To this end, RFMH is focused on implementing activities and initiatives to reduce disparities in access, quality, and treatment outcomes for underserved populations. A critical component of these efforts is ensuring that RFMH is a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees' unique attributes and skills are valued and utilized to support the mission of the Agency. RFMH is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.

The Research Foundation is a private not-for-profit corporation and is not an agency or instrumentality of the State of New York. jobs.description:

At Columbia, we’re as passionate about the outdoors as you are. And while our gear is available worldwide, we’re proud to be based in the Pacific Northwest, where natural wonders are our playground.

  

Every product we make and every task we undertake is inspired by the famous words of our founder Gert Boyle: “It’s perfect. Now make it better.” As pioneers of relentless improvement, we are constantly evolving.

  

We believe the outdoors is ours to protect and strive to keep our planet healthy. We believe in empowering people to experience the outdoors to the fullest.

**ABOUT THE POSITION**

This role works across sales, merchandising, planning, marketing, and operations to ensure products, information, and programs are executed accurately and on time.

jobs.title: Account Manager (Mid-Market)
jobs.description:
Vendelux is building the category-defining platform for event marketing intelligence.

Events are one of the largest and most impactful marketing channels, yet historically one of the least measurable. Vendelux brings transparency and performance to this space — helping companies discover, evaluate, and optimize their event strategy with data.

Our platform powers thousands of event decisions by delivering proprietary, AI-driven insights across hundreds of thousands of events globally. At the core of our platform is a robust ecosystem of event organizer partnerships — where organizers share first-party data, enabling richer insights for customers while receiving benchmarking and audience intelligence in return. From identifying the highest ROI conferences to enabling targeted meeting programs, Vendelux helps companies turn events into a predictable and scalable growth engine.

In addition, Vendelux Meetings extends our platform by turning insights into pipeline — using AI to identify high-value attendees and proactively book 1:1 meetings between our customers and their ideal prospects at events. This enables go-to-market teams to drive measurable ROI and maximize every event interaction.

Founded in 2021, Vendelux is a Series B SaaS company backed by top-tier investors including FirstMark. We partner with many of the fastest-growing companies in the world, and our team includes leaders from Bain, ZoomInfo, Shutterstock, FanDuel, Compass, Airbnb, Forter and beyond.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

We're looking for an Account Manager who has been in the trenches of a high-growth B2B SaaS company, knows what it takes to manage a complex book of business, and is excited by the opportunity to help shape how we do Customer Success at Vendelux. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment and love the challenge of turning at-risk accounts into long-term champions, we want to talk.

This role is hybrid, 4 days a week in our NYC office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Function as a true account manager across the full customer lifecycle — from onboarding and enablement through renewals, upsells, and negotiations
* Own a portfolio of accounts simultaneously, managing competing priorities with urgency and precision — expect to juggle 9+ active workstreams at any given time
* Lead structured onboarding and training programs that drive fast time-to-value and long-term product adoption
* Run proactive meeting campaigns and renewal processes, ensuring no account goes dark or falls through the cracks
* Negotiate renewals and expansions with confidence, building strong business cases that demonstrate clear ROI
* **Drive retention with a relentless, creative approach — exhaust every option before accepting churn, whether that's a LinkedIn message, an in-person office visit, a free pilot extension, or bringing in leadership to save the relationship**
* Travel to customer sites a minimum of 2 days per month to strengthen relationships and accelerate outcomes
* Contribute to community building across the customer base through webinars, case studies, and events

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a hybrid of both — ideally at a B2B SaaS or high-growth tech company
* Proven track record of owning the full client lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewals, upsells, and negotiations
* Thrives in a fast-paced environment managing multiple high-priority accounts simultaneously without dropping the ball
* Relentless when it comes to retention — you get creative, you show up, and you don't give up on an account easily
* Comfortable traveling to meet customers in person and building face-to-face relationships
* Highly accountable self-starter who doesn't need to be chased for updates
* Strong communicator who can navigate difficult conversations with customers and internal stakeholders alike

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive base salary and bonus
* Equity
* Healthcare covering medical, dental and vision
* 401(k)
* Catered lunch every day in our NYC office
* Unlimited PTO plus two company-wide shutdowns during the July 4th week and the Christmas – New Year's week

Not all candidates will check all of the requirements listed above and that’s ok! We are open to great people from non-traditional backgrounds.

Vendelux is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Compensation Range: $120K - $150K

jobs.title: Public Relations Account Executive
jobs.description:
**Company**

Development Counsellors International (DCI), headquartered in New York City, is looking to hire a Public Relations Account Executive (AE) to join our “place marketing” agency. For more information about DCI – named one of Outside Magazine’s “Best Places To Work” – visit www.aboutdci.com.

DCI is an equal opportunity employer and has taken a Diversity Pledge to ensure our agency advances racial justice, identifies unconscious bias, educates our staff, and uses our place marketing platform to advocate for change. Our agency is also a member of the Diversity Action Alliance and Black Travel Alliance. While this job posting is a guide, we welcome applicants that may bring diverse backgrounds, ideas and experiences to DCI.

**Job Description**  
Do you love pitching stories to reporters? Do you love reading and watching the news every day? Are you interested in finding new places to tell stories (podcasts, Substack, etc.)? Are you interested in how cities and states are creating marketing campaigns to attract businesses and jobs to their communities?

DCI is seeking a Public Relations Account Executive for our economic development public relations team. You don’t have to be an economist or have a background in economic development to apply. All you need are the qualifications below. We’ll give you the training necessary to become an expert in economic development. Combine that with your existing skills and talents, and you’ll be ready to thrive in your new role.

How is success defined in this role? The AE will be the client service team’s expert in identifying the local news of the day in each community (4-5 clients) and nationally; seeks new mediums (podcasts, newsletters, etc.) for the team to pitch stories; consistently suggests pitch ideas to teammates based on the daily news; helps senior publicists develop strong lists of reporters to pitch and understands what makes a solid pitch list; clips and reports the team’s media results with minimal supervision; demonstrates critical thinking skills by suggesting next steps in pitch development or a project; has a strong desire to start developing relationships with reporters.

We are looking for a teammate who loves reading the news, consistently brings ideas to the table, takes initiative on tasks and projects, and brings a positive attitude.

**Qualifications**

* 2 years of PR and media relations experience required

* Agency experience is highly valued

* Passion for reading, watching, and/or listening to the news daily

* A strong desire to work with reporters and build meaningful relationships with media

* Strong, creative, AP-style writing is an absolute must with the ability to “spot” a story angle

* Strong project management skills (organized, takes initiative, etc.) and the ability to work at a high pace, balance multiple clients, work on tight deadlines, delegate responsibilities and tasks

* Excellent interpersonal skills when working with teammates, clients, and reporters

* Highly motivated individual and team player with a drive to hit goals with a solutions-oriented mindset

* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Muck Rack, Wrike, or similar platforms; or takes initiative to learn a new program quickly

* BA or BS in Public Relations, Communications, Economics, Business or Journalism preferred

* Applicants must be U.S. citizens or have all necessary approvals to live/work in the U.S. We don’t provide sponsorship.

**Benefits**

* Flexible Paid Time-Off

* Unique “open book” management approach that delivers performance-based incentives

* Hybrid work - 2 days in the office

* Medical/dental/vision coverage

* Mentorship and professional development opportunities

* 401k match

* Cell phone reimbursement

* Base salary 53-65k + bonuses

SS&C is a leading provider of mission-critical, AI-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.

  

**Job Description**

  

**Enterprise Account Manager**

  

**Location(s)** : Waltham, MA | New York City, NY

  

**Get To Know The Team:**

The Account Management Team’s job is to drive an exceptional customer experience while ensuring sustained success with SS&C Intralinks products and solutions. You will work alongside a diverse, talented, and highly motivated global team who all share a primary focus on customer success.

  

As an Account Manager you are responsible for Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM) and will secure long-term client relationships, drive adoption of the SS&C Intralinks platform, and help customers achieve their desired business outcomes.

  

**Why Join SS&C**

SS&C combines proprietary technology with deep industry expertise to support complex financial and health care operations. Our teams design, implement, and operate solutions that help clients manage data, automate processes, and scale their businesses with confidence.

You will work with industry experts, modern platforms, and evolving technologies, gaining exposure to real-world operational challenges and large-scale enterprise environments.

**How You Will Make an Impact**

* Own the overall relationship with assigned clients across all SS&C Intralinks product lines
* Proactively manage each customer's business needs and environments - actively seek opportunities to up-sell, cross-sell and generate referrals
* Consistently achieve monthly and quarterly renewal revenue targets, striving for a high percentage of on-time revenue retention
* Ensure that customers derive maximum value from their investments and fully leverage their subscriptions and services on an ongoing basis
* Maintain high-touch relationship with clients by communicating with them regularly regarding open projects, cases, etc
Manage key contacts relationships while leading renewal contract negotiations  

  

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
* 1-2 years of software sales experience
* Strong written and oral communication skills with proven ability to initiate and manage relationships with customers of all levels
* Self-starter with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Track record for consistently exceeding daily, weekly and monthly activity metrics
* Ability to work in a fast paced, team environment.
* Strong work ethic, self-motivated and driven
* CRM experience, preferably Salesforce
* Previous experience with SaaS
Experience in the financial services industry

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a Partner Account Manager to drive revenue growth and channel success by managing and expanding relationships with our strategic reseller and distributor partners. This role is responsible for increasing market share, building executive-level relationships, and driving awareness of the Ekahau product line solutions across the partner ecosystem. The ideal candidate has proven experience in a channel sales model, preferably in software and/or SaaS sales, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and grow revenue across a defined set of strategic reseller and distributor accounts
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners and act as their advocate within Ekahau
* Execute joint business plans to drive pipeline creation, deal registration, and quarterly sales targets
* Drive awareness and market share by engaging strategically with partner sales reps and identifying key influencers within partner organizations
* Cultivate and develop executive-level relationships with partner stakeholders to align on business goals and long-term success
* Conduct regular partner business reviews, sales trainings, and enablement sessions to ensure partner readiness and motivation
* Identify, develop, and close co-sell opportunities with and through the partner ecosystem
* Ensure Salesforce hygiene is maintained through accurate and timely opportunity updates, partner activity tracking, and pipeline forecasting
* Coordinate with internal teams including marketing, sales, support, and product to deliver a seamless partner experience
* Monitor partner performance and market trends to provide insights and drive program improvements
* Ensure partner compliance with Ekahau’s channel policies, pricing structures, and deal registration guidelines

**Job Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in channel sales, partner account management, or similar roles
* Proven success working with resellers, VARs, distributors, or system integrators
* Experience selling software/SaaS solutions; wireless networking or IT infrastructure a strong plus
* Deep understanding of the channel sales lifecycle and partner co-selling dynamics
* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with sales reps and executive decision-makers
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and strategic account management skills
* Strong discipline in maintaining CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and reporting accuracy
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred
* Ability to travel occasionally to partner or industry events (10–20%)

**About**

Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi-source data with industry-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights.

Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected.

**About Accenture**

Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at

accenture.com

.

**Compensation Range**

Ookla provides a range for the base pay. Factors that may be used to determine your actual pay may include your specific job related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location. The salary compensation for this role is $100,000 to $130,000. Individual pay within the compensation range for this business unit specific role is determined based on a variety of factors including experience, scope of the role, capabilities to perform the role, education and training, as well as business and company performance.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Manager, Apple News Ads Account Management
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
At Apple, we focus deeply on our customers' experience. Apple Ads brings this same approach to advertising, helping people find exactly what they're looking for and helping advertisers grow their businesses. Our technology powers ads and sponsorships across Apple Services, including the App Store, Apple News, and MLS Season Pass. Everything we do is designed for trust, connection, and impact: We respect user privacy, integrate advertising thoughtfully into the experience, and deliver value for advertisers of all sizes—from small app developers to big, global brands. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone.
  
  
Description
  
  
We're looking for a strategic and operationally excellent leader to serve as a player-coach on our Apple News Account Management team. In this dual-capacity role, you will manage and develop a small team of Account Managers while personally owning a portfolio of high-tier strategic accounts — spanning top-spending performance advertisers and global brand campaigns. This role spans full-funnel campaign management, from partnering with Client Partners on initial pitch through post-sale analysis, while also setting the standard for how the team delivers best-in-class service to clients and agency partners. The ideal candidate brings deep managed service and direct IO digital advertising account management experience, strong agency and client relationships, and the leadership presence to coach an Account Manager through a complex renewal conversation as confidently as they navigate one themselves.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in digital advertising account management, within a premium content, publisher, or digital media environment
* 2+ years of people management experience, leading and developing account managers or campaign management teams — or a seasoned senior AM with demonstrated leadership, mentorship, and readiness to step into management
* Proven experience personally managing high-tier or strategic accounts end-to-end, including complex multi-stakeholder campaigns across global brand and performance advertisers
* Deep familiarity with media planning, ad operations, and campaign management workflows — including proficiency with systems such as OperativeOne, Freewheel, Salesforce, or equivalent
* Strong track record of building trusted senior-level relationships with media agencies and brand marketers
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage both a team's book of business and a personal account portfolio simultaneously

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience in Apple News, digital publishing, or editorial-driven advertising environments
* Strong analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to use campaign data to drive optimizations, upsell recommendations, and renewal strategy
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to navigate sensitive client situations and influence across internal and external stakeholders
* Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a track record of identifying and resolving unstructured problems before they escalate
* Experience working across deal structuring, pricing frameworks, and advertiser commitment tracking (upfronts, contractual obligations, etc.)
* Track record of developing talent and elevating team performance in fast-paced, matrixed organizations
* Genuine passion for Apple's brand, editorial values, and commitment to upholding the standards that define the Apple News experience

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $170,900 and $298,000, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.  
  
  

Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We seek to promote equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Learn more about your EEO rights as an applicant

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Rippling Spend
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a self-driven, growth minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid-remote US-based Account Management team. As a Rippling Spend, Account Manager, you are the CEO of your book of business. Your primary objective is to increase the value of Rippling’s Spend for your customers through growth, expansion and retention of the Rippling Spend SKUs (Expenses, Corp Cards, Bill Pay, and Travel). Rippling Spend is a unique product pillar as our revenue overwhelmingly relies on consumption. Account managers will own the relationship with the Financial Suite at their accounts and will partner with the HR/IT Account Managers. If a sales-driven Account Manager role in an extremely fast-paced environment, along with being a founding member of a team ignites your excitement, you’re in the right place.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: renewals, company growth, EBRs, increased credit/spending needs, etc.
* Consult with clients to understand their finance needs through a solutions-based selling approach
* Navigate a sales process by building relationships with multiple stakeholders through remote meetings
* Build and manage a pipeline of expansion and growth/consolidation opportunities to achieve monthly targets
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting
* Partner with cross-functional product, support, and customer operations teams to ensure customer success and secure long term commitments
* Take an entrepreneurial approach to the role

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 3+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Experience in FinTech or background in Accounting/Finance preferred
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a sales discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long term commercial relationships
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

jobs.description:
**Client Success Associate**

Sage is on a mission to improve care and quality of life for older adults, starting with those residing in senior living facilities. Falls are the leading cause of injury-related death among adults over 65. And yet, fall prevention and emergency response systems for older adults are archaic and ineffective. At Sage we've built a more modern way of understanding when older adults need help, including methods for residents to alert caregivers when in need of help, and corresponding software for caregivers to triage response. Our company mission is to create a product that our client counterparts love, and this role is a key part of that objective.

Sage is a small, tight team of ambitious, multi-disciplinary entrepreneurs. We are a software-enabled, mission-driven company, and are focused only on the problems that are central to achieving that mission. At Sage, we work hard and fast but also know that to build a truly important company, we need to treat our work as a marathon, and not a sprint. The journey matters.

**About this Role**

As part of our Client Success team, you'll play a critical role in supporting and nurturing the adoption of Sage among our end user community. You'll use data to identify key trends, challenges, and opportunities, working closely with clients to foster a positive user experience and ensure our product helps them achieve their goals.

We're seeking a **Client Success Associate** who is passionate about user engagement and data analysis. In this role, you will focus on driving the adoption of Sage's Care Platform offerings: Sage Core, Sage Detect, and Sage Insight. Your responsibilities will include providing proactive support, monitoring user engagement, and using data-driven insights to help communities maximize the value of Sage. You'll work closely with community management to build relationships, encourage best practices, and enable action upon data-driven recommendations to support their operational efficiency.

This is a dynamic, fast-paced, and data-focused role ideal for someone who is both customer-oriented and comfortable working with metrics and analytics to improve client outcomes

**Responsibilities**

* **Client Management:**
* + Act as a primary point of contact for clients at the community level; regularly checking in with community leadership to ensure they are satisfied with the product and offer support or training as needed.
  + Surface identified Sage super-users/champions to the Community and Marketing teams for potential involvement in various campaigns, webinars, training sessions, etc.
  + Identify at-risk communities and work proactively to address potential issues that could lead to churn or disengagement.
* **Data-Driven Value Creation & ROI Realization:**
* + Ensure communities achieve measurable ROI by leveraging Sage data to make operational decisions.
  + Surface opportunities for communities to increase care revenue, reduce liability, and improve operational efficiencies, *and* ensure action is taken on such recommendations.
  + Train community management on the Sage Analytics platform, ensuring adoption and understanding of how to leverage the data to support their overall operations.
  + Proactively reach out to communities based on usage data to provide assistance, share best practices, or resolve any challenges preventing full product adoption.
* **Engagement and Adoption:**
* + Drive user engagement and product adoption within client communities by building strong, trust-based relationships with users.
  + Monitor app usage patterns and identify areas where clients can improve their engagement with the platform.
  + Use data and client feedback to deliver personalized recommendations that increase adoption and ensure clients are realizing the full potential of the product.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
* + Work closely with the broader Client Success team, Product, and Support teams to relay customer feedback, product challenges, and feature requests.
  + Share valuable insights and best practices with internal teams to enhance overall customer experience and improve the onboarding process.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 2-4 years of experience in a customer-facing role (Customer Success, Account Management, or similar).
* Proven experience building and maintaining client relationships
* A customer-first mindset with a passion for helping others succeed through the use of technology.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze customer data and translate it into actionable insights.
* Comfortable using data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Tableau, Excel, etc.) to track customer success metrics and create reports.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage and support clients effectively.
* Familiarity with data-driven decision-making, customer success metrics, and tracking product usage.
* Ability to collaborate across teams (Sales, Product, Marketing) and advocate for customer needs internally.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Healthcare or healthtech experience a plus.
* Familiarity with customer success tools (e.g., Gainsight, HubSpot, Zendesk) and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce).

**Benefits and Pay**

Our headquarters are located in New York City's Union Square. We believe in cross team collaboration. We think good ideas can come from anyone, and we've designed our processes to encourage participation from all. While we take our mission seriously, we don't take ourselves too seriously. We like to host offsites, outings, and team meals where we can connect as people, not just as colleagues. We offer office lunch and a fully stocked snack bar. While we are an in office culture, we allow up to 2 remote days per week.

Our benefits package for employees includes competitive base compensation along with stock options. The expected annual salary range for this role is $75,000 to $100

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Culture moves fast, this team helps make sure JPMorgan Chase moves with it, credibly and at scale. JPMorgan Chase's Talent Partnerships & Culture team sits within the firm's global marketing organization. We design and deliver programs that connect our brands and businesses to culture through strategic relationships with talent and tastemakers across entertainment, sports, media, and the creator economy.

Our work includes building long-term partnerships with celebrities, musicians, artists, athletes, and creators; developing social-first content and experiences; and activating paid and earned opportunities that expand reach, relevance, and measurable business impact across our lines of business.

As an Associate, Creator & Influencer Marketing within the Talent Partnerships & Culture team, you execute partnerships end-to-end, from identifying talent through launch, measurement, and wrap-up. This role supports marketing aligned with our auto-brand relationships and will partner closely with the Talent Lead on our team to bring creator programs from opportunity identification through contracting and delivery.

Success in this role requires someone who brings creative, culture-forward thinking to every brief, spotting talent and partnership ideas that feel native to platforms, while also operating with speed, precision, and strong process management in a highly regulated environment. You'll manage workflows across multiple internal and external stakeholders (creators, managers/agencies, and internal partners across Brand, Social, Paid Media, PR, Legal, Risk/Compliance, and Finance), keeping momentum, alignment, and accountability throughout.

The right candidate is curious, a champion of ideation (with conviction), and a strong steward of process, someone who can push work forward without being bound to “how it's always been done.”

**Job Responsibilities**

* **Bring creative partnership thinking:** Contribute ideas for creator pairings, content angles, and program concepts that are culturally relevant and platform-native, while aligned to business goals.
* **Be a doer in the creator economy:** Support creator partnerships from outreach through launch, ensuring momentum, clear next steps, and on-time delivery.
* **Manage complex stakeholder workflows:** Own day-to-day coordination across internal team leads and the external partners, keeping everyone aligned on deliverables, timelines, and approvals.
* **Drive process efficiently:** Run structured workflows (identification/selection, briefing, negotiations, contracting, execution, measurement), maintain documentation, and proactively flag blockers.
* **Support deal execution and contracting:** Partner with the Talent Lead to move deals through; manage deliverables tracking, usage rights inputs, disclosures, and approval routing.
* **Operate with rigor in a regulated environment:** Coordinate early and often with Legal/Controls/Risk and maintain strong operational hygiene to ensure compliant, brand-safe execution.
* **Drive measurable performance:** Contribute to measurement/reporting including, defining success metrics and KPIs, analyze results (reach, engagement, traffic, conversion), synthesize insights, and optimize creator mix, content approaches, and media tactics over time.

**Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities**

* 3-7 years experience, currently working in creator/influencer marketing (brand-side, agency, or creator/talent management), with hands-on experience supporting live creator programs.
* Experience working with Auto brands and/or adjacent brands (e.g. sport, spirits, travel, luxury brands)
* Proven ability to execute with creativity and precision, you bring smart ideas, then you make them real.
* Demonstrated strength in process management, you know how to work through structured steps, keep approvals moving, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Comfortable partnering with and influencing many stakeholders at once, brand leads, creators, talent reps, agencies, and internal cross-functional teams, while maintaining clarity, urgency, and professionalism.
* Strong written/verbal communication and an ability to translate ambiguity into a clean plan (owners, dates, dependencies, next steps).
* Highly organized, responsive, and deadline-driven; you anticipate issues early and escalate intelligently.

**Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities**

* Experience working with or in highly regulated industries.
* Experience integrating creators into paid media strategies.
* Familiarity with creator measurement approaches and the ability to partner deeply with analytics.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. * Maintain organized content files and support the social media content calendar by helping coordinate assets, posting needs, deadlines, and upcoming opportunities.
* Provide additional social media and content support as needed, including trend monitoring, content research, asset gathering, and day-to-day marketing requests.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in social media, content creation, digital marketing, communications, or a related role; strong internship or portfolio experience may also be considered.
* Hands-on experience capturing high-quality photo and video content using a smartphone, camera, or similar content-production tools.
* Basic video-editing skills and comfort creating short-form content for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, or similar channels.
* Basic graphic-design capabilities using tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or similar design platforms.

* Excellent written communication skills with the judgment to represent a brand professionally in comments, messages, and public interactions.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple content requests, deadlines, and deliverables at once.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and content needs may shift quickly.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and know when to escalate questions, customer issues, or brand-sensitive situations.
* Comfortable using approved company-issued devices and account-access procedures to manage social media channels securely.
* A collaborative, hands-on attitude and willingness to support content capture at events, productions, showrooms, and other locations as needed.

**Preferred Skills**

* Comfortable appearing on camera when appropriate, whether demonstrating a product, participating in a tutorial, showing hands in a how-to video, or being featured in brand content.
* Experience working with influencers, creators, designers, or brand partners and tracking campaign deliverables.
* Experience with social media management, scheduling, analytics, or listening tools is a plus.
* Interest in interior design, kitchen and bath, home products, building products, architecture, or related industries is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means Fabuwood is producing more strong, timely content internally while maintaining an active and responsive social presence. Content is captured consistently, social communities receive thoughtful engagement, influencer commitments are tracked, and the marketing team has a dependable partner who can identify opportunities and help move content from idea to execution.

At Fabuwood, we value people who take ownership of their work, bring ideas forward, move quickly without sacrificing quality, and contribute to a collaborative, results-focused marketing team.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Founding Sales Development Representative**  
Brooklyn, New York (Hybrid)

**Ready to stop running on someone else’s playbook and write your own?**

**About Haast**

We aren’t experimenting with AI. We’re shipping one of the first enterprise-grade AI platforms for compliance, already in production with global enterprises. Our platform helps legal, compliance and marketing teams move through reviews up to 80% faster, with a 4x boost in productivity.

We’ve recently raised a $12M Series A led by Peak XV Partners, with DST Global and Airtree. Now we’re building the commercial engine to match.

Think Canva for design. Atlassian for projects. Haast for compliance.

**Why this role exists**

Compliance is a $50B global opportunity, and every deal we close starts with a conversation. Right now, nobody’s job is to start them. That’s where you come in.

As our first SDR, based in our Brooklyn office, you’ll work side by side with our CEO and Founding Enterprise AE. You’ll build the pipeline behind Haast’s next stage of growth and write the playbook every SDR after you will run.

**What you’ll own**

Most of your time goes into creating qualified pipeline. The rest goes into building the process that lets others do the same.

**Pipeline**

* **Phone first:** Run daily outbound across phone, email and LinkedIn into target accounts. The phone is your first move, not your last resort.
* **Warm pipeline:** Work the demand that marketing generates through content, events, webinars and community, and act fast on the inbound signals that matter, from website visits to demo requests.
* **Events into meetings:** Personally invite the right people beforehand, then co-own follow-up with our Founding Enterprise AE to book meetings while the momentum is there.
* **Discovery that holds up:** Run structured discovery against our ideal customer profile and book meetings our Founding Enterprise AE accepts.

**Playbook and process**

* **Write the playbook:** Build, test and document talk tracks, sequences, objection handling and qualification criteria. Keep what works and drop what doesn’t.
* **Own the numbers:** Keep our CRM clean, report on meetings booked, acceptance rate and conversion, and recommend changes to tools and process.
* **AI as leverage:** Use AI to multiply your output across account research, personalization and sequencing, and keep testing new workflows.
* **Voice of the market:** Bring what you hear on calls back to marketing, product and sales leadership: which titles respond, which industries engage, the objections and the buying triggers. Your insight sharpens our ICP and personas.

**You might be a fit if you:**

* **Have outgrown your seat:** You’re an experienced SDR or BDR from B2B software who consistently hits or beats meeting and pipeline targets, and you’re ready for a role you get to build.
* **Improve the process, not just follow it:** You’ve built or rebuilt sequences and you can show what changed as a result.
* **Love the numbers:** You track your own funnel, run message tests, and can explain what you changed and why.
* **Hold your own with senior buyers:** You’re comfortable engaging director level and above, and bringing several functions into one conversation.
* **Write and speak with credibility:** Clear, concise and confident with people who are paid to be skeptical.
* **Already work with AI:** Claude, ChatGPT or similar are part of how you research and prospect today, not something you’re planning to try.
* **Know the tools:** HubSpot (or Salesforce), LinkedIn Sales Navigator and any other tools you've seen work well.

**Nice to have, but not essential**

* Selling to marketing, compliance, legal or risk buyers
* A background in compliance software, regtech or legal tech
* Time at an early-stage startup where things moved quickly!

**Why Haast**

* **A founding seat:** Be the first SDR at a Series A company and shape how we go to market.
* **Clear (and fast) growth pathway:** Build the function, prove it works, then lead the team that follows or step up into enterprise sales ownership if that's the route you want to take
* **Compensation:** Base salary $60-$80k USD with up to 30% on top in commission and meaningful equity options.
* **Flexibility:** Hybrid from our Brooklyn office.
* **Benefits:** Health insurance, 401k and generous PTO
* **Learning velocity:** Learn more in 12 months than most roles offer in three years, with daily access to our CEO and Founding Enterprise AE.
* **Traction behind you:** You’ll be opening doors for a product global enterprises already trust, with the results to back it up.

**Ready to build the pipeline you’ll be talking about for the rest of your career?**

**How to apply**

Apply with your CV and the first email you’d send to win a meeting. Pick a company you think should be talking to Haast and write to their Head of Compliance in under 120 words. If you used AI to help, tell us how.

At Haast, we believe bold ideas come from diverse perspectives. We’re committed to building a team that reflects the world we work in, across gender, background, orientation, ability and experience. Even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

*Applications reviewed on an ongoing basis, no closing date.*

Compensation Range: $60K - $80K

The ideal candidate has experience in bakery or food service operations, strong administrative and organizational skills, and the ability to help maintain efficient production schedules while ensuring consistent product quality.

* Coordinate ingredient preparation and ensure supplies are available for scheduled production.
* Monitor inventory levels and communicate replenishment requirements.
* Assist with purchasing coordination and supplier communications.
* Maintain production records, preparation schedules, and inventory documentation.
* Monitor product freshness, storage, labeling, and rotation procedures.

Qualifications and Requirements

* High school diploma or equivalent required.

* Understanding of basic baking and food preparation procedures.
* Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
* Ability to maintain accurate production and inventory records.
* Familiarity with ingredient storage and food safety procedures.
* Basic computer skills, including spreadsheets and scheduling tools.
* Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and meet production deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Skills

* Experience coordinating bakery, pastry, or commercial kitchen production.
* Familiarity with breads, cakes, pastries, cookies, and specialty desserts.
* Knowledge of production planning and inventory management.
* Ability to communicate effectively with bakers, suppliers, and supervisors.
* Understanding of food-cost control and waste reduction.

Work Environment

jobs.title: Development Assistant
jobs.description:
**About the Organization — Violence Intervention Program (VIP)**  
Established by Black and Latina activists in 1984, the Violence Intervention Program (VIP) is NYC’s only culturally specific organization with a mission to address domestic and sexual violence within Latine communities. Each year, we provide intensive support and services to 3,500+ survivors and children and reach 15,000+ community members through community events and preventive education. We are committed to developing innovative programs that respond to the needs of our diverse community and reflect our organizational values.  
  
**About the Role — Development Assistant**  
This is an excellent opportunity for an organized professional looking to build a career in nonprofit fundraising while advancing social justice. As Development Assistant, you’ll work closely with the Associate Director of Individual Giving and Operations to gain hands-on experience in fundraising administration, database management, donor stewardship, and special events.  
  
As part of our small but mighty team, you’ll collaborate with colleagues across VIP, interact directly with donors, partners, and members of our Board of Directors, and jump in wherever needed to keep development operations running smoothly.  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Support individual and corporate fundraising efforts, including donor and prospect research.
* Maintain accurate donor records, gifts, interactions, and notes in VIP’s donor database.
* Prepare gift acknowledgments, thank-you letters, and other donor correspondence.
* Generate donor reports, prospect and mailing lists, and other fundraising data.
* Help keep development files, documents, and procedures organized and up to date.
* Support fundraising events, including VIP’s annual benefit, with event logistics, communications, materials, donor lists, sponsor recognition, and follow-up.
* Provide administrative support to the Associate Director, including calendar management, meeting agendas, notes, and follow-up.

  
**What You’ll Need**

* 1–3 years of relevant work experience.
* **Systems and data comfort:** High comfort managing data, generating reports, and maintaining donor database integrity with precision.
* **Organizational chops:** Strong project coordination and time-management skills, with pride in delivering accurate, orderly, and polished work.
* **Exceptional communication:** Clear, thoughtful written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage thoughtfully with diverse community partners and donors.
* **Mission alignment:** A grounded commitment to VIP’s mission of supporting survivors and ending gender-based violence.
* **Demonstrated discretion:** Commitment to maintaining the confidentiality of sensitive donor and organizational information.
* **Language:** Fluency in English is required; Spanish proficiency or fluency is a strong plus.

  
**Compensation & Benefits**  
As an organization led by and for people of color and survivors of violence, we care deeply about our team’s wellness. We offer unlimited PTO, flexible work schedules, a hybrid workplace, health benefits coverage up to 90% for staff and their families, a 403(b) retirement plan, a staff-led wellness committee, and dedicated time to connect as a team. We are an evolving workplace and welcome input from our staff as we continue building an affirming, uplifting culture.  
  
The hiring range for this position is an annual salary of $60,000 to $65,000. The final salary within this range is determined based on candidate qualifications and relevant experience. To uphold equity across our team, once an offer is made, we do not negotiate compensation.  
  
**Location & Schedule**

* Office Location: East Harlem (near the Lexington & 125th St station).
* In-Office Schedule: Full-time position requiring at least two days per week in the office.
* Remote Schedule: You are welcome to work remotely during regular office hours the remainder of the week, with occasional additional in-person days based on operational and event needs.
* Event Attendance: Core member of the development team expected to attend all VIP fundraising and networking events.

  
**The Application Process**  
VIP has engaged Equitable Hiring Group to support this hiring process. To apply, please complete the short form to the right.  
  
Please submit your application by **Wednesday, November 11th.** Our simple process makes it easy to apply early!  
  
To ensure an equitable review, we ask that you remove the names of the schools you attended (both undergraduate and graduate) from your resume. Please retain the degree itself. For example, instead of "Greendale Community College - B.A. Economics," simply list "B.A. Economics."  
  
This evaluation process will follow practices shown to reduce bias in decision-making and may be different from other application processes you have experienced.  
  
The overall evaluation process will look to follow this anticipated timeline:

* Early November: Selected candidates will be asked to complete a short-answer questionnaire.
* Mid-November: Selected candidates will participate in a video interview with VIP staff.
* Late November: Selected candidates will be asked to complete a paid, timed trial project.
* Early December: Selected candidates will participate in a video panel interview with multiple team members.
* Early December: Finalist candidates will come for an in-person interview and tour our office.
* Mid December: Offer extended.
* Early January: Anticipated Start Date

If you have any questions about the opportunity, please email abe@equitablehiringgroup.com.

Position Summary:

The Project Coordinator serves as an integral partner to our Project Managers, helping drive the day-to-day execution and coordination of projects from initiation through closeout. Reporting to the Administration/Coordination Group Leader, this highly collaborative role goes beyond traditional administrative support by taking ownership of project coordination activities, anticipating project needs, proactively resolving issues, and helping keep projects organized and on schedule. This is far more than a traditional administrative support role. Successful Project Coordinators become trusted business partners who help Project Managers increase capacity, improve project execution, and deliver exceptional client service.

  
  

Working closely with Project Managers, technical teams, clients, and project stakeholders, the Project Coordinator develops an understanding of each Project Manager’s workflow, communication style, and project priorities. As Project Coordinators gain experience and build trusted partnerships with their Project Managers, they assume increasing responsibility throughout the project lifecycle, becoming an extension of the Project Manager and creating the capacity for Project Managers to focus on technical leadership, client relationships, and strategic project delivery.

  
  

In this role you will join a dedicated professional team working to make a difference for our Federal Government Clients to:

* Partner proactively with Project Managers and technical teams to coordinate project activities and support fast-paced, successful project delivery.
* Manage electronic and physical project documentation, including filing, document control, scanning, tracking, distribution, and record management.
* Coordinate project meetings by scheduling, preparing agendas, capturing action items, and following up on outstanding tasks.

* Manage office supplies, equipment, shipping, printing, and other operational support activities as needed.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including itineraries, and logistical planning
* Research local conditions and provide logistical support for domestic and international project activities.
  

What Success Looks Like in This Role:

Successful Project Coordinators are trusted partners who become an extension of their Project Managers. Rather than simply completing assigned tasks, they take ownership of project coordination activities, solve problems before they become obstacles, and contribute directly to the successful delivery of projects while creating additional capacity for Project Managers to focus on strategic and technical leadership.

When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

* Critical hours are over lunch Monday - Friday (9 am – 3 pm) but responsibilities may span 8am-4pm, depending on the market and need

  
**Requirements**

**Who You Are:**

* You love building relationships with customers and enjoy customer service
* You are friendly, high energy and love interacting with other people
* You are savvy with technology and will be comfortable in a fast-paced start-up
* You are resourceful, exhibit grace under pressure, and know you’re capable of finding solutions
* You are a strong communicator and self-starter
* You are organized and detail oriented. Type-A personality is a plus!
* You’re someone who knows the local territory and gets around efficiently in your own car
* You’re looking for a steady part-time job (between 20 - 25 hours per week) during regular business hours and value flexibility
* Prior catering or serving experience strongly preferred

  
**Benefits**

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Revenue Cycle Operations Coordinator supports day-to-day revenue cycle activities, including provider enrollment, payer maintenance, medical records coordination, and revenue integrity tasks. Reports directly to the Vice President, Revenue Operations.

**JOB SPECIFIC EXPECTATIONS**

**Provider Enrollment & Payer Operations**

* Independently coordinate ongoing provider and group enrollment maintenance, including CAQH updates, attestations, and payer demographic changes.
* Maintain and monitor payer portals, ensuring accuracy of provider, banking, and participation data across payers.
* Review, triage, and process payer correspondence and mail, identifying action items and coordinating follow-up with internal stakeholders.
* Support and respond to Medicaid and commercial payer audits, including documentation preparation, variance identification, and issue resolution.
* Perform provider group audits (e.g., Verity), analyzing payer alignment and initiating corrective actions as needed.
* Conduct EFT and virtual credit card (VCC) payment audits, identifying discrepancies, recommending resolutions, and escalating issues when appropriate.

**Payor Strategy & Rate Maintenance**

* Coordinate maintenance of contracted payer rates within the corporate master rate file.
* Validate rate accuracy against executed agreements and escalate discrepancies for review.
* Support payer strategy initiatives by maintaining clean, reliable rate and participation data.

**Revenue Cycle & Medical Records Coordination**

* Oversee chart flow tracking within Arietis, identifying bottlenecks and coordinating resolution to support timely billing.
* Coordinate provider schedule and reconciliation activities related to GCA and records management.
* Manage secure file transfers via FTP, ensuring compliance with HIPAA and company data security standards.
* Maintain and update operations master files, exercising judgment to ensure data integrity across revenue cycle workflows.
* Perform records reconciliation, evaluating completeness and resolving discrepancies.
* Coordinate scanning and indexing of medical records received in the ATL office to ensure timely system availability.
* Monitor and independently respond to inquiries received via **service@crhanesthesia.com**, determining appropriate resolution paths.

**MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS**

***Education & Qualifications:***

**Education**: High School Diploma with Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent healthcare revenue cycle experience considered.

**Licensure & Certifications:** N/A

**Previous Experience:** Two years plus (2+ ) years of experience in revenue cycle operations, provider enrollment, payer maintenance, or medical records coordination required in a healthcare setting.

**Skills**:Working knowledge of CAQH, payer portals, EFT/VCC payments, and healthcare data management systems, with strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and self-driven, able to manage multiple workflows independently, meet strict deadlines, and perform well in a fast-paced, high-volume healthcare environment. Effective written and verbal communicator with excellent customer service skills, capable of engaging internal teams, providers, payers, and external partners while maintaining a high level of confidentiality. Maintains accurate physician and practitioner credentialing and payer enrollment records across multiple states and builds productive relationships with payer representatives, providers, and billing and contracting partners to support timely enrollment, issue resolution, and protect revenue integrity.

**Computer Skills:** The credentialing department works in a mostly paper-free environment. Previous experience with provider credentialing/enrollment software (i.e. VerityStream) necessary. Expertise in Microsoft Office (Excel and Word). Proficiency with standard business software (Microsoft Windows, and PowerPoint) and using a laptop and mobile device is required.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

CVS Media Exchange (CMX) is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for suppliers, merchants, stores, brand advertisers, and agencies. Our full-funnel solutions leverage CVS Health’s first-party data, extensive national reach, and trusted presence in local markets to help brands build awareness, engage consumers, and drive conversion.

As Manager of Experiential Marketing, you will support the development and execution of CMX experiential programs that bring brands to life through immersive, consumer-centered experiences in and around CVS locations and across relevant cultural, seasonal, and health-focused moments. You will report directly to the Lead Director of Category Marketing. This is an individual contributor role; you will lead work through influence, cross-functional partnership, and day-to-day direction of external agencies and vendors. You will manage programs from intake through execution and measurement, partnering closely with senior leadership, Sales, Merchandising, Front Store Marketing, Store Operations, Legal, Finance, Product, Measurement, and external agencies. Your work will help transform experiential into a scalable, fully monetized CMX capability that generates incremental brand investment, strengthens the total shopper journey, and delivers measurable value for advertisers and CVS Health.

**Responsibilities include, but not limited to:**

* Lead end-to-end execution of experiential programs, including intake, scoping, project plans, budgets, agency coordination, approvals, onsite delivery, and post-event reporting.
* Partner with Sales and senior experiential leadership to assess opportunities, shape integrated experiential and media solutions that connect physical, in-store, and omnichannel touchpoints, support advertiser pitches, and help convert qualified pipeline into incremental brand investment.
* Coordinate cross-functional partners and external agencies to ensure programs meet scope, timing, budget, quality, operational, legal, compliance, and brand standards.
* Build scalable, market-ready experiential offerings through packages, pricing and margin guardrails, playbooks, intake processes, clear roles, and repeatable workflows that enable Sales to bring solutions to market efficiently.
* Track portfolio financials, program profitability, operational performance, risks, and KPIs; provide leadership-ready reporting and translate results into case studies and optimization recommendations that increase advertiser value, repeat investment, and commercial impact.

**Location:**

This role is hybrid and commutable to one of the following Corporate Hubs, working in the office 2 days a week (Tuesday and Wednesday):

* Wellesley, MA
* Woonsocket, RI
* New York, NY – Soho office
* Chicago, IL

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience in experiential marketing, integrated marketing, retail marketing, shopper marketing, event marketing, media, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex experiential or integrated marketing programs from concept and scoping through execution, measurement, and post-program reporting.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and directing agencies, vendors, production partners, or client-facing teams to deliver against defined scope, timing, and quality expectations.
* Experience managing program budgets, financial trade-offs, timelines, scopes of work, dependencies, and execution risks.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate strategy into action, communicate with senior stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience within a retail media network, retailer, CPG company, agency, or healthcare organization, with an understanding of advertiser objectives and the retail media landscape.
* Experience developing integrated programs that connect physical experiences with in-store, digital, social, or offsite media to drive awareness, engagement, trial, and conversion.

* Familiarity with experiential measurement methodologies and performance indicators such as attendance, engagement, dwell time, impressions, sales lift, brand lift, and return on ad spend.
* Experience navigating legal, compliance, store operations, field execution, or other requirements within a complex or regulated environment.

**Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Advertising, or a related field, or equivalent (HS Diploma and 4 years of experience) required

40

Full time

$66,330.00 - $159,120.00

The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.

**Marketing and Communications Coordinator – Society of Helpers & Casa Esperanza**

**Location:** Chicago, IL (Multiple Sites)  
**Position Type:** Full-Time (35 hours/week)  
**Reports To:** Provincial Team  
**Salary:** Negotiable based on experience

**About the Society of Helpers & Casa Esperanza**

The Society of Helpers is an international congregation of Catholic sisters spanning 24 countries, dedicated to easing the suffering of those most in need. Our Sisters devote their lives to God and channel their energies into addressing the needs of those wounded in their human dignity. Recognizing that everyone has unique gifts, the Helpers respond to a common mission: to help in all manner of good. They advocate for social justice and support local communities through our sponsored ministries, including Casa Esperanza and The Circle.

**Position Summary**

The Society of Helpers is seeking a creative, organized, and digitally savvy Marketing and Communications Coordinator to lead our digital and print communications strategies. In this role, you will be the primary voice for the **Society of Helpers and Casa Esperanza** across web, social, and print platforms.

A critical component of this role involves spearheading the redesign and ongoing management of our websites, executing a comprehensive social media strategy, and utilizing modern marketing tools to enhance our mission. The successful candidate will be highly adept at managing dual content calendars, expertly balancing a strong institutional, donor-facing voice for the Society of Helpers with community-focused storytelling for Casa Esperanza.

**Professional Development Opportunity:** The first 4–6 months of this role will include direct mentorship, strategic onboarding, and hands-on CMS/social media training from a senior Communications Consultant to ensure the successful candidate is fully equipped to manage our digital ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Social Media Management & Community Engagement**

* **Facebook Strategy:** Maintain the primary hub for community updates, local event pages, volunteer coordination, and donor engagement.
* **Instagram Strategy:** Utilize visual storytelling (including Reels and Stories) to showcase behind-the-scenes ministry work, share inspirational quotes/stories aligned with Catholic social teaching, and connect with younger demographics.
* **YouTube Strategy:** Organize and promote video content, including interviews with the Sisters, impact stories, and ministry highlights.
* **Content Calendar & Authentic Storytelling:** Develop and manage a unified, dual-brand content calendar that aligns with our organizational goals, the liturgical year, and specific ministry events. Focus on authentic storytelling highlighting the people we serve, our staff, and the Sisters' mission.
* **Active Community Management:** Treat social media as a two-way conversation. Promptly respond to comments and direct messages, thank supporters publicly, and foster a safe, welcoming online environment.
* **Policy & Boundary Compliance:** Establish and monitor community guidelines. Ensure all digital interactions adhere to the Society's values, maintaining Christian charity in all discussions, and strictly upholding confidentiality and safe environment protocols.
* **Analytics & Growth:** Track platform-specific metrics (engagement rates, reach, and follower growth) rather than just passive posting. Repurpose top-performing content and report on social media effectiveness quarterly.

**Digital Strategy & Web Management**

* **Website Redesign & Upkeep:** Lead the creation, redesign, and daily management of websites for the Society of Helpers and Casa Esperanza. Ensure sites are mobile-responsive, user-friendly, and meet modern accessibility standards (WCAG).
* **Content Creation:** Research, write, edit, and produce compelling web content, including landing pages, online donation forms, and blog posts.
* **SEO Integration:** Ensure website content and social media captions utilize relevant keywords so that those seeking community support or wishing to volunteer can easily find our ministries.

**E-Communications & AI Integration**

* **Email Marketing:** Implement and manage e-communications and targeted newsletters for donors of the Society of Helpers and Casa Esperanza. Provide organization-wide e-communication support.
* **Technology Utilization:** Responsibly leverage modern tools, including generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Canva AI) for content ideation and workflow efficiency, and social media management platforms (e.g., Sprout Social, Hootsuite) for scheduling, while maintaining the authentic voice of the Helpers.

**Public Relations & Print Media**

* **Print Advertising & Press:** Research, design, and oversee printed promotional materials, press releases, and public relations initiatives.
* **Internal Communications:** Collaborate with staff to achieve professional standards for internal communications (e.g., Voices of Hope, Province Shares).

**Project & Relationship Management**

* **Archival Collaboration:** Coordinate with the community to ensure culturally and historically significant digital and print materials are properly preserved.

**Education & Experience**
