This role runs our community websites, paid media, and local listings, manages the digital media budget, and is accountable for qualified leads, cost per lead, and lead-to-sale conversion across our manufactured housing and RV communities.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES****:**

* **Websites & Conversion:**
  + Own all Lakeshore community websites, including hosting, domains, uptime, and updates (currently on GoDaddy).
  + Keep community content, available homes, pricing, and promotions current, including pop-ups and featured offers.
  + Maintain the custom property sites (including Cameron and Harbor Belle RV Resort) and their booking or inquiry paths.
  + Improve conversion: forms, click-to-call, chat, page speed, and mobile experience.
  + Own local and on-site SEO for every community.
* **Paid Media:**
  + Plan, build, and optimize Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Local) and Meta (Facebook and Instagram) campaigns.
  + Run community-level demand campaigns alongside home-level and site-level ads, rather than a fixed number of homes per community.
  + Own the monthly media budget and reallocate it by cost per qualified lead and lead-to-sale, not by impression or click volume.
  + Manage listing and marketplace channels where they produce leads (for example MHVillage for homes and RV booking platforms for Harbor Belle).
* **Lead Capture, Routing & Reporting:**
  + Make sure every lead source (web, phone, social, listings) is tracked and lands in Yardi CRM IQ with the correct source and community.
  + Set up and maintain call tracking, UTM standards, pixels, and conversion events.
  + Partner with the sales team and our AI lead-response agent so every lead gets a fast first response and a clean handoff.
  + Publish a weekly dashboard by community: leads, cost per lead, tours or bookings, and sales.
* **Local Listings & Social:**
  + Take ownership of all community Google Business Profiles and Facebook pages, consolidating admin access under Lakeshore.
  + Keep hours, photos, and offers accurate, and manage review requests and responses.
  + Post a steady cadence of community and available-home content.
* **Vendors & Transition:**
  + Lead the handover from Lead Crossing: logins, ad accounts, pixels, domains, hosting, and historical performance data.
  + Brief and manage the graphic designer and any other freelancers or vendors.
* **First 90 Days:**
  + Days 1 to 30: take full control of all accounts and domains from Lead Crossing, audit tracking, and set a baseline for leads and cost per lead by community.
  + Days 31 to 60: rebuild paid campaign structure, fix lead routing into CRM IQ, and launch the weekly dashboard.
  + Days 61 to 90: hit agreed lead targets for priority communities, including the Harbor Belle RV season and Bay City home sales.
* **Other duties deemed necessary by supervisor**

**REQUIRED SKILLS & Qualifications****:**

* 4 or more years in digital marketing with hands-on Google Ads and Meta Ads management and budget ownership.
* Experience running websites on a CMS (WordPress or similar), including hosting and DNS basics.
* Strong analytics: GA4, Google Tag Manager, call tracking, and conversion tracking.
* CRM experience; Yardi, Entrata, or another property management CRM is a plus.
* Real estate, manufactured housing, multifamily, RV, or hospitality marketing experience preferred.
* Comfort working remotely with on-site community teams and a small corporate team.

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - AWS | Full-Time | Hybrid
new_jobs.description:
**About us:**

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

**The Role:**  
  
You're an ideal candidate if you're hungry and eager to help grow the AWS practice at Tech Holding. We want someone who has experience or is excited to work in a startup-like environment. This is not the role for you if you've only worked inside a structured system where every process is laid out for you. We're looking for someone who wants to grow and expects to move into an AE role.

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) builds qualified pipeline for Tech Holding's AWS practice. You will prospect into startup, SMB and enterprise companies, work alongside AWS sellers to find co-sell opportunities, and book intro and discovery meetings for our Account Executives and Solutions Architects.

* **Reports to:** AWS Sales and Practice Lead
* **Career path:** A defined path to Account Executive in 18 to 24 months for consistent performers

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Outbound prospecting*

* Run multi-channel outbound (phone, email, LinkedIn) into target accounts and personas: CTOs, VPs of Engineering, IT Directors, founders and operations leaders
* Build and work account lists around plays we run today: VMware to AWS migration, data center exits, AI and generative AI roadmaps, Amazon Connect contact center modernization, and AWS Marketplace listings for ISVs
* Research each account before outreach and tie the message to a real business problem, not a product pitch
* Respond to and qualify inbound leads from the website, campaigns and events within one business day

*AWS co-sell*

* Build working relationships with AWS Account Managers, Partner Development Managers and Partner Sales Managers
* Map AWS seller territories to our target accounts and run joint outreach on priority accounts
* Register qualified opportunities in AWS Partner Central (ACE) and keep them updated so Tech Holding earns AWS co-sell credit
* Spot customers who qualify for AWS funding programs (migration, modernization and AI assessments) and flag them to the Account Executive

*Qualification and handoff*

* Run first-call discovery to confirm business need, timeline, decision process and budget authority
* Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and Solutions Architects, with clear notes on what the prospect cares about
* Log every activity, contact and opportunity in the CRM so pipeline data is accurate

*Events and marketing support*

* Drive registrations and follow-up for AWS co-hosted events, executive dinners and roundtables
* Give feedback to marketing on which messages, lists and plays are landing
* Post and engage on LinkedIn to build a professional presence in the AWS ecosystem

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 2 years in a quota-carrying B2B SDR, BDR or inside sales role, with a record of hitting or beating quota. If you have less than 2 years in sales but relevant experience in a related role, we still encourage you to apply.
* Experience selling technology or IT services (cloud, SaaS, managed services or consulting)
* Working knowledge of core AWS cloud concepts: compute, storage, databases, migration and why companies move to the cloud
* Strong writing. You can turn a technical benefit into a short, clear message a busy executive will answer
* Comfort on the phone and with cold outreach, and the resilience to handle objections and rejection
* Daily CRM discipline (Salesforce or HubSpot)
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner within the first 90 days (Tech Holding covers the exam)

**Nice to have:**

* Prior work at an AWS consulting partner, AWS reseller, MSP or at AWS itself
* Experience with AWS Partner Central (ACE) and the AWS co-sell process
* Familiarity with AWS funding and partner programs (MAP, POCs, assessments)
* AWS AI Practitioner certification, or a working grasp of generative AI use cases
* Hands-on with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Outreach or Salesloft
* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience

**Traits we hire for:**

* Owns the number without being told
* Works well with engineers and Solutions Architects

**Location:**

* Hybrid - 4 Days per week in our Downtown Los Angeles (DTLA) office.
* Occasional visits to AWS locations across SoCal, Seattle and Austin as business needs require.

**Travel:**

* 1 to 2 trips per quarter, plus regional AWS offices, customer meetings, AWS Summits and partner events

**Employment Type:**

* Full-Time

**Compensation:**

* The base salary range for this role is $60,000 to $72,000, with on-target earnings of $80,000 to $100,000, including commission.

**What we offer:**

* AWS certification exams and training paid by Tech Holding
* Direct exposure to AWS sellers, partner programs and executive events
* A clear promotion path to Account Executive
* 401(k)
* Unlimited PTO

**Work authorization:**

* Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Tech Holding is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and we consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. new_jobs.description:
The Judicial Council of California is accepting applications for the position of Administrative Coordinator with the Center for Judicial Education and Resources.

The Administrative Coordinator position schedules and performs project management and logistical tasks required to deliver education programs and products for judges, court managers and court personnel. Staff work directly in support of faculty and collaborate with attorneys and education developers responsible for the training and recruitment of faculty and creation of course content. They coordinate the work performed by staff providing A/V Support Services, Distance Education/Media Production, meeting planning and contracting, course and program registration, printing, and mailing, and provide program management for live programs, supporting faculty and working with local site personnel. Staff work independently on more than one assigned program or product at a time and are responsible for coordinating the implementation of a variety of delivery mechanisms including but not limited to the following: in-person conferences, statewide institutes, regional education courses, local training courses, webinars, online videos, podcasts, and videoconferences.

This position is responsible for providing the full range of administrative coordination and project management duties required to deliver multiple education programs currently planned and approved by the Judicial Council as part of the Judicial Branch Education Plans. In order to ensure the work of the office is completed within budget and on time, assignments will be flexibly rotated, therefore, this position is expected to be capable of performing all coordinator duties.

**The Judicial Council**
  
The Judicial Council of California is the policy setting body for the state court system and has constitutionally conferred statewide rule-making authority. This authority includes developing, advocating for, and allocating the judicial branch budget. A majority of Council members are California state justices and judges; however, the Council also includes lawyers, legislators, and court administrators.

By enhancing its role as a leadership, knowledge, and service resource for the judicial branch, the Judicial Council’s staff organization seeks to continue to evolve as one of California’s most dynamic public service entities, focused on improving access to justice for all Californians by innovating and responding to the changing needs of the courts and the public. As a government body charged with improving the statewide administration of justice, the Judicial Council has multiple offices with diverse responsibilities relating to court policy and operations. As employees of the council, every member of staff should view and approach their work as one Judicial Council with a public service mission that is greater than the sum of its parts.

The Judicial Council strives for work-life balance, including substantial vacation and holiday time. In addition, we offer an excellent benefits package, including pension, medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending, up to $130 per month reimbursement for qualifying commuting costs, student loan forgiveness as part of Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), and retirement savings plans. The San Francisco office is only a 7-minute walk from the downtown Civic Center BART station. In Sacramento, the office is located minutes from downtown, just north of Discovery Park.

**Company Description**

Located in the heart of Silicon Valley, Tenergy is a total power solution provider in the rechargeable battery and renewable energy industry. With over 20 years of reputation and track record, Tenergy is a recognized leading battery brand and Power solution partner in the fast growing renewable energy sector. Tenergy serves broad spectrums of customers for their applications including consumer electronics smart devices, industrial application, medical, electrical transportation and power storage. The application and business possibility with our products is endless with increasing needs for mobility and durable power. Tenergy offers competitive products in the market due to our global logistics, scale, quality, and commitment to customer satisfaction.

 **Job Description**

Tenergy Corporation is seeking a Logistics Operations Coordinator to support our daily logistics, shipping, and warehouse operations. This is a hands-on role that combines shipping and freight coordination with daily warehouse activities. The position works closely with the sales, warehouse, customer service, and accounting teams to process shipments, provide freight quotations, coordinate carriers, manage inventory-related transactions, and ensure customer orders are fulfilled accurately and on time. The role also involves hands-on order picking, packing, labeling, and shipment preparation as needed.

This position is well suited for either a motivated recent college graduate seeking to build a career in operations and logistics or an experienced operations professional who enjoys a combination of logistics coordination and hands-on operational work in a fast-paced environment.

**Duties may include**

* Prepare domestic and international shipping quotations for the sales team using parcel and freight carriers.

* Monitor shipments and proactively resolve delivery delays, damage claims, or transportation issues.
* Maintain shipment tracking records and provide shipment status updates to internal teams and customers.
* Coordinate special project shipments and customer-specific logistics requirements.

**Warehouse Operation and Coordination**

* Coordinate with teammates to ensure timely receiving, inventory transfers, order pulling, and outbound shipments.
* Verify receiving records, inventory movements, and warehouse transactions before processing ERP updates.
* Assist in investigating inventory discrepancies and help maintain inventory accuracy.
* Support warehouse workflow planning to improve shipping efficiency and on-time order fulfillment.
* Order picking, packing, labeling, and shipment preparation as needed to support daily operations.

 **Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Relevant internship or work experience in logistics, warehouse operations, customer service, or operations is a plus.
* Experience with ERP systems is preferred.
* Experience with UPS, FedEx, freight carriers, Amazon Seller Central, or ShipStation is a plus.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office skills.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
* Self-motivated with a strong customer-service mindset and the ability to work effectively across departments.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager (Mid-Market)
new_jobs.description:
Vendelux is building the category-defining platform for event marketing intelligence.

Events are one of the largest and most impactful marketing channels, yet historically one of the least measurable. Vendelux brings transparency and performance to this space — helping companies discover, evaluate, and optimize their event strategy with data.

Our platform powers thousands of event decisions by delivering proprietary, AI-driven insights across hundreds of thousands of events globally. At the core of our platform is a robust ecosystem of event organizer partnerships — where organizers share first-party data, enabling richer insights for customers while receiving benchmarking and audience intelligence in return. From identifying the highest ROI conferences to enabling targeted meeting programs, Vendelux helps companies turn events into a predictable and scalable growth engine.

In addition, Vendelux Meetings extends our platform by turning insights into pipeline — using AI to identify high-value attendees and proactively book 1:1 meetings between our customers and their ideal prospects at events. This enables go-to-market teams to drive measurable ROI and maximize every event interaction.

Founded in 2021, Vendelux is a Series B SaaS company backed by top-tier investors including FirstMark. We partner with many of the fastest-growing companies in the world, and our team includes leaders from Bain, ZoomInfo, Shutterstock, FanDuel, Compass, Airbnb, Forter and beyond.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

We're looking for an Account Manager who has been in the trenches of a high-growth B2B SaaS company, knows what it takes to manage a complex book of business, and is excited by the opportunity to help shape how we do Customer Success at Vendelux. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment and love the challenge of turning at-risk accounts into long-term champions, we want to talk.

This role is hybrid, 4 days a week in our NYC office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Function as a true account manager across the full customer lifecycle — from onboarding and enablement through renewals, upsells, and negotiations
* Own a portfolio of accounts simultaneously, managing competing priorities with urgency and precision — expect to juggle 9+ active workstreams at any given time
* Lead structured onboarding and training programs that drive fast time-to-value and long-term product adoption
* Run proactive meeting campaigns and renewal processes, ensuring no account goes dark or falls through the cracks
* Negotiate renewals and expansions with confidence, building strong business cases that demonstrate clear ROI
* **Drive retention with a relentless, creative approach — exhaust every option before accepting churn, whether that's a LinkedIn message, an in-person office visit, a free pilot extension, or bringing in leadership to save the relationship**
* Travel to customer sites a minimum of 2 days per month to strengthen relationships and accelerate outcomes
* Contribute to community building across the customer base through webinars, case studies, and events

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a hybrid of both — ideally at a B2B SaaS or high-growth tech company
* Proven track record of owning the full client lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewals, upsells, and negotiations
* Thrives in a fast-paced environment managing multiple high-priority accounts simultaneously without dropping the ball
* Relentless when it comes to retention — you get creative, you show up, and you don't give up on an account easily
* Comfortable traveling to meet customers in person and building face-to-face relationships
* Highly accountable self-starter who doesn't need to be chased for updates
* Strong communicator who can navigate difficult conversations with customers and internal stakeholders alike

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive base salary and bonus
* Equity
* Healthcare covering medical, dental and vision
* 401(k)
* Catered lunch every day in our NYC office
* Unlimited PTO plus two company-wide shutdowns during the July 4th week and the Christmas – New Year's week

Not all candidates will check all of the requirements listed above and that’s ok! We are open to great people from non-traditional backgrounds.

Vendelux is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Compensation Range: $120K - $150K

new_jobs.description:
**Company**

Development Counsellors International (DCI), headquartered in New York City, is looking to hire a Public Relations Account Executive (AE) to join our “place marketing” agency. For more information about DCI – named one of Outside Magazine’s “Best Places To Work” – visit www.aboutdci.com.

DCI is an equal opportunity employer and has taken a Diversity Pledge to ensure our agency advances racial justice, identifies unconscious bias, educates our staff, and uses our place marketing platform to advocate for change. Our agency is also a member of the Diversity Action Alliance and Black Travel Alliance. While this job posting is a guide, we welcome applicants that may bring diverse backgrounds, ideas and experiences to DCI.

**Job Description**  
Do you love pitching stories to reporters? Do you love reading and watching the news every day? Are you interested in finding new places to tell stories (podcasts, Substack, etc.)? Are you interested in how cities and states are creating marketing campaigns to attract businesses and jobs to their communities?

DCI is seeking a Public Relations Account Executive for our economic development public relations team. You don’t have to be an economist or have a background in economic development to apply. All you need are the qualifications below. We’ll give you the training necessary to become an expert in economic development. Combine that with your existing skills and talents, and you’ll be ready to thrive in your new role.

How is success defined in this role? The AE will be the client service team’s expert in identifying the local news of the day in each community (4-5 clients) and nationally; seeks new mediums (podcasts, newsletters, etc.) for the team to pitch stories; consistently suggests pitch ideas to teammates based on the daily news; helps senior publicists develop strong lists of reporters to pitch and understands what makes a solid pitch list; clips and reports the team’s media results with minimal supervision; demonstrates critical thinking skills by suggesting next steps in pitch development or a project; has a strong desire to start developing relationships with reporters.

We are looking for a teammate who loves reading the news, consistently brings ideas to the table, takes initiative on tasks and projects, and brings a positive attitude.

**Qualifications**

* 2 years of PR and media relations experience required

* Agency experience is highly valued

* Passion for reading, watching, and/or listening to the news daily

* A strong desire to work with reporters and build meaningful relationships with media

* Strong, creative, AP-style writing is an absolute must with the ability to “spot” a story angle

* Strong project management skills (organized, takes initiative, etc.) and the ability to work at a high pace, balance multiple clients, work on tight deadlines, delegate responsibilities and tasks

* Excellent interpersonal skills when working with teammates, clients, and reporters

* Highly motivated individual and team player with a drive to hit goals with a solutions-oriented mindset

* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Muck Rack, Wrike, or similar platforms; or takes initiative to learn a new program quickly

* BA or BS in Public Relations, Communications, Economics, Business or Journalism preferred

* Applicants must be U.S. citizens or have all necessary approvals to live/work in the U.S. We don’t provide sponsorship.

**Benefits**

* Flexible Paid Time-Off

* Unique “open book” management approach that delivers performance-based incentives

* Hybrid work - 2 days in the office

* Medical/dental/vision coverage

* Mentorship and professional development opportunities

* 401k match

* Cell phone reimbursement

* Base salary 53-65k + bonuses

new_jobs.title: Client Success Associate
new_jobs.description:
**Client Success Associate**

Sage is on a mission to improve care and quality of life for older adults, starting with those residing in senior living facilities. Falls are the leading cause of injury-related death among adults over 65. And yet, fall prevention and emergency response systems for older adults are archaic and ineffective. At Sage we've built a more modern way of understanding when older adults need help, including methods for residents to alert caregivers when in need of help, and corresponding software for caregivers to triage response. Our company mission is to create a product that our client counterparts love, and this role is a key part of that objective.

Sage is a small, tight team of ambitious, multi-disciplinary entrepreneurs. We are a software-enabled, mission-driven company, and are focused only on the problems that are central to achieving that mission. At Sage, we work hard and fast but also know that to build a truly important company, we need to treat our work as a marathon, and not a sprint. The journey matters.

**About this Role**

As part of our Client Success team, you'll play a critical role in supporting and nurturing the adoption of Sage among our end user community. You'll use data to identify key trends, challenges, and opportunities, working closely with clients to foster a positive user experience and ensure our product helps them achieve their goals.

We're seeking a **Client Success Associate** who is passionate about user engagement and data analysis. In this role, you will focus on driving the adoption of Sage's Care Platform offerings: Sage Core, Sage Detect, and Sage Insight. Your responsibilities will include providing proactive support, monitoring user engagement, and using data-driven insights to help communities maximize the value of Sage. You'll work closely with community management to build relationships, encourage best practices, and enable action upon data-driven recommendations to support their operational efficiency.

This is a dynamic, fast-paced, and data-focused role ideal for someone who is both customer-oriented and comfortable working with metrics and analytics to improve client outcomes

**Responsibilities**

* **Client Management:**
* + Act as a primary point of contact for clients at the community level; regularly checking in with community leadership to ensure they are satisfied with the product and offer support or training as needed.
  + Surface identified Sage super-users/champions to the Community and Marketing teams for potential involvement in various campaigns, webinars, training sessions, etc.
  + Identify at-risk communities and work proactively to address potential issues that could lead to churn or disengagement.
* **Data-Driven Value Creation & ROI Realization:**
* + Ensure communities achieve measurable ROI by leveraging Sage data to make operational decisions.
  + Surface opportunities for communities to increase care revenue, reduce liability, and improve operational efficiencies, *and* ensure action is taken on such recommendations.
  + Train community management on the Sage Analytics platform, ensuring adoption and understanding of how to leverage the data to support their overall operations.
  + Proactively reach out to communities based on usage data to provide assistance, share best practices, or resolve any challenges preventing full product adoption.
* **Engagement and Adoption:**
* + Drive user engagement and product adoption within client communities by building strong, trust-based relationships with users.
  + Monitor app usage patterns and identify areas where clients can improve their engagement with the platform.
  + Use data and client feedback to deliver personalized recommendations that increase adoption and ensure clients are realizing the full potential of the product.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
* + Work closely with the broader Client Success team, Product, and Support teams to relay customer feedback, product challenges, and feature requests.
  + Share valuable insights and best practices with internal teams to enhance overall customer experience and improve the onboarding process.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 2-4 years of experience in a customer-facing role (Customer Success, Account Management, or similar).
* Proven experience building and maintaining client relationships
* A customer-first mindset with a passion for helping others succeed through the use of technology.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze customer data and translate it into actionable insights.
* Comfortable using data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Tableau, Excel, etc.) to track customer success metrics and create reports.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage and support clients effectively.

Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited, and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.  
  
Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.  
  
Powered by technology and a network of 3,500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Sales, travel, and happy pets too.**

  

We are looking for a Territory Sales Representative in Illinois to join our high performing sales team.

  

Working in the assigned Territory: Illinois, you will represent Champion Petfoods, maker of premium ORIJEN® and ACANA® foods, to retail and distribution partners. It goes without saying, this is a high visibility role.

  

The Territory Sales Representative (TSR) is responsible for executing Champion Petfoods' sales strategy within an assigned territory by growing sales, expanding distribution, strengthening retailer relationships, and delivering excellent in-store execution of the ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands.

  

Working closely with retailers, distributors, and the Regional Sales Manager, the TSR contributes to territory growth through effective account management, product education, merchandising, and sales execution.

  

This position is open to candidates who currently reside in Chicago or Milwaukee.

**What a typical day looks like:**

  

**Sales & Territory Management**

* Execute territory plans aligned with regional sales objectives.
* Grow sales and distribution within existing retail accounts.
* Identify and pursue new account opportunities.
* Maintain consistent account coverage based on territory priorities.
Monitor competitor activity, pricing, and market trends.  

  

**Retail & Distributor Partnership**

* Build strong relationships with retailer and distributor partners and CPF Distributor managers.
* Conduct joint sales calls and ride-alongs with distributor representatives.
* Support distributor sales efforts through product education and field collaboration.
Deliver business-building recommendations to retail partners.  

  

**Merchandising & Execution Excellence**

* Ensure Champion merchandising standards are maintained in all priority accounts.
* Increase brand visibility through displays, secondary placements, signage, and promotional execution.
* Monitor assortment, shelf placement, and pricing compliance.
Address execution gaps and follow through on corrective actions.  

  

**Training & Brand Advocacy**

* Conduct product training and education sessions for retail associates and distributor teams.
* Represent Champion Petfoods at industry, retailer, and consumer events.
Serve as a passionate ambassador for ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands.  

  

**Administration & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate CRM records and sales activity reporting.
* Complete expenses, reports, and administrative tasks within established deadlines.
Provide regular territory updates, opportunities, and market insights to the Regional Sales Manager.  

  

**Background & Experience:**

* Outside sales experience ideally within the pet specialty industry, consumer packaged goods/retail experience is a plus.
* Proven ability to build and maintain relationships.
* Must be able to handle, manage and overcome objections encountered within the sales process.
* Remote team collaboration with a proactive, results-driven mindset.
* Proven experience using MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint along with a CRM program.
* Experience presenting to large and small groups.
* Flexibility to travel on average 50% within territory, with overnights required
* Availability for work events on evenings and weekends as needed
Occasionally, be able to lift and/or carry up to 40lbs.  

  

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Sales Performance**

* Territory sales growth versus target
* New account acquisition
Growth of key retail accounts  

  

**Distribution**

* New SKU placements
* Distribution gains across priority accounts
Assortment expansion  

  

**Retail Execution**

* Merchandising compliance
* Display placement and promotional execution
Territory coverage achievement  

  

**Customer Development**

* Retail training sessions completed
* Distributor ride-alongs completed
Customer relationship effectiveness  

  

**Operational Excellence**

* CRM compliance
* Timely reporting and administration
Budget and expense management adherence  

  

**Success Profile**

* Strong relationship-building and communication skills
* Results-oriented with a proactive mindset
* Organized and able to manage territory priorities effectively
* Comfortable presenting and training individuals or groups
Passion for customer service, sales execution, and continuous learning  

  

**Accountability Statement**

Success in this role is measured by achievement of sales goals, distribution growth, execution excellence, customer engagement, and effective territory management. The TSR is expected to take ownership of their territory, consistently execute company priorities, and contribute to sustainable growth across retail and distributor partners.

  
  

**What can you expect from Champion?**

* **Safety:** a strong commitment to ensure all people are provided with a safe, healthy and respectful environment.

* **Industry Competitive Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision and employee assistance programs to meet your individual or family needs.

Performance is measured against funded loan volume and count, inbound and outbound calls, talk time, productive borrower contacts, speed-to-lead, follow-up completion, lead-to-application and application-to-funding conversion rates, pipeline pull-through, and closing timeliness.

* Maintain accurate CRM, telephony, and loan origination system records.
* Manage loan pipelines, outstanding conditions, and aging loans while coordinating with processing, underwriting, and closing teams.
* Follow applicable mortgage requirements involving disclosures, fair lending, HMDA reporting, borrower contact consent, do-not-call requests, and protection of borrower information.
* Follow approved call guides, participate in call monitoring and coaching, and apply feedback.
* Escalate borrower complaints, complex loan scenarios, compliance concerns, and system issues through established channels.
* Complete required training, attend team meetings and product updates, and collaborate across the organization.
* Perform other assigned duties and responsibilities.

The position serves as an important connection point between the Business Development team, fleet customers, distributors, and other business partners. The role helps ensure that business programs, customer information, pricing, systems, and related processes are effectively maintained and supported.

While the position will initially have a strong focus on fleet programs, it is designed to provide flexibility to support additional Business Development and cross-functional initiatives as organizational priorities evolve.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business and Program Support:** Provide ongoing administrative and operational support for fleet programs, customer initiatives, and other Business Development activities.
* **Pricing and Data Administration:** Support the maintenance, accuracy, and coordination of customer, product, pricing, and other business information across company systems.
* **Systems and Process Support:** Maintain business and program information within applicable systems and support the continued development and improvement of processes, tools, and workflows.
* **Customer and Distributor Coordination:** Serve as a resource and point of coordination for fleet customers, distributors, and other stakeholders regarding program information, account updates, pricing, and related business needs.
* **Program Implementation:** Support the onboarding and implementation of new customers, programs, pricing initiatives, and other Business Development opportunities.
* **Reporting and Analysis:** Prepare and maintain recurring and ad hoc reports and analyses to support program management, customer requirements, and business decision-making.
* **Issue Resolution:** Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to research and resolve data, pricing, account, system, and program-related questions or discrepancies.
* **Cross-Functional Support:** Collaborate with Business Development and other departments on projects and initiatives that support organizational priorities and growth.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and effectiveness of business and program administration, systems, reporting, and related processes.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Zero to three years of relevant professional experience.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain attention to detail.
* Comfortable working with data, pricing information, business systems, and structured processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with internal teams as well as customers, distributors, and other external business partners.
